name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.bentP_lower_bound
statement:
theorem bentP_lower_bound (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 1 / 16 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 7 / 10) :
    (1 : ℝ) / 100 ≤ bentP t

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.bentP_pos
statement:
theorem bentP_pos (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 1 / 16 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 7 / 10) :
    0 < bentP t

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.finite_posterior_lower_bound
statement:
theorem finite_posterior_lower_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (w u : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hsum : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (hu : ∀ i, (u i) ^ 2 ≤ 1) :
    1 - (∑ i, w i * (u i) ^ 2) / 2 - (∑ i, w i * (u i) ^ 4) / 2 ≤
      ∑ i, w i * Real.sqrt (1 - (u i) ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.four_dimensional_bias_margin
statement:
theorem four_dimensional_bias_margin :
    (1 : ℝ) / 32 < 1 - Real.sqrt 15 / 4

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.four_dimensional_intermediate_gap
statement:
theorem four_dimensional_intermediate_gap {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (w u : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hsum : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (hu : ∀ i, (u i) ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 1 / 16 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 7 / 10)
    (hQ₂ : (∑ i, w i * (u i) ^ 2) = (1 + t) ^ 4 / 16)
    (hQ₄ : (∑ i, w i * (u i) ^ 4) ≤ bentH t ^ 2 / 256) :
    (1 : ℝ) / 100 < (∑ i, w i * Real.sqrt (1 - (u i) ^ 2)) -
      Real.sqrt 15 / 4 + 1 - Real.sqrt (1 - t)

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.four_dimensional_weighted_hellinger_gap
statement:
theorem four_dimensional_weighted_hellinger_gap {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (w u : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hsum : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (hu : ∀ i, (u i) ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 1 / 16 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 7 / 10)
    (hmean : (∑ i, w i * u i) ^ 2 = 1 / 16)
    (hQ₂ : (∑ i, w i * (u i) ^ 2) = (1 + t) ^ 4 / 16)
    (hQ₄ : (∑ i, w i * (u i) ^ 4) ≤ bentH t ^ 2 / 256) :
    (1 : ℝ) / 100 < (∑ i, w i * Real.sqrt (1 - (u i) ^ 2)) -
      Real.sqrt (1 - (∑ i, w i * u i) ^ 2) + 1 - Real.sqrt (1 - t)

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.four_low_noise_ratio_gt_one
statement:
theorem four_low_noise_ratio_gt_one (α S ratio : ℝ) (hα : α ≤ 1 / 12)
    (hS : (3 + 3 * Real.sqrt 2 + 2 * Real.sqrt 3) / 8 ≤ S)
    (hratio : (1 - α) ^ 3 * S ≤ ratio) : 1 < ratio

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.four_sensitivity_constant
statement:
theorem four_sensitivity_constant :
    (4 : ℝ) / 3 < (3 + 3 * Real.sqrt 2 + 2 * Real.sqrt 3) / 8

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.fourthMomentExpression_identity
statement:
theorem fourthMomentExpression_identity (e t : ℝ) :
    fourthMomentExpression e t = bentH t ^ 2 / 256 -
      3 / 16 * (e - 2) * t ^ 2 * (1 - t) ^ 4

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.fourthMomentExpression_le
statement:
theorem fourthMomentExpression_le (e t : ℝ) (he : 2 ≤ e) :
    fourthMomentExpression e t ≤ bentH t ^ 2 / 256

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.gap_gt_bentP
statement:
theorem gap_gt_bentP (t R Q₂ Q₄ : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1)
    (hR : 1 - Q₂ / 2 - Q₄ / 2 ≤ R)
    (hQ₂ : Q₂ = (1 + t) ^ 4 / 16)
    (hQ₄ : Q₄ ≤ bentH t ^ 2 / 256) :
    bentP t < R - Real.sqrt 15 / 4 + 1 - Real.sqrt (1 - t)

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.high_noise_curvature_constant
statement:
theorem high_noise_curvature_constant :
    ((109 : ℝ) ^ 3 / 4000000) ^ 2 < (1 - (169 / 200 : ℝ) ^ 4) ^ 3

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.sqrt_chord
statement:
theorem sqrt_chord (a b t : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    (1 - t) * Real.sqrt a + t * Real.sqrt b ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 - t) * a + t * b)

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.sqrt_one_sub_lower
statement:
theorem sqrt_one_sub_lower (z : ℝ) (hz0 : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1) :
    1 - z / 2 - z ^ 2 / 2 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - z)

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.sqrt_one_sub_upper
statement:
theorem sqrt_one_sub_upper (z : ℝ) (hz0 : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1) :
    Real.sqrt (1 - z) ≤ 1 - z / 2 - z ^ 2 / 8

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.twoNoiseR_eq_twoRootR
statement:
theorem twoNoiseR_eq_twoRootR (ρ : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) :
    twoNoiseR ρ = twoRootR ρ

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.twoNoiseR_gap_bound
statement:
theorem twoNoiseR_gap_bound (ρ : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) :
    (4 + Real.sqrt (2 : ℝ) - 3 * Real.sqrt 3) / 4 * ρ ^ 2 ≤
      twoNoiseR ρ - Real.sqrt 3 / 2 + 1 - Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.twoNoiseR_hellinger_strict
statement:
theorem twoNoiseR_hellinger_strict (ρ : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) :
    Real.sqrt 3 / 2 - twoNoiseR ρ < 1 - Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.twoRootR_chord
statement:
theorem twoRootR_chord (ρ : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) :
    Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2) *
        ((1 - ρ ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt 3 / 2) + ρ ^ 2 * ((2 + Real.sqrt 2) / 4)) ≤
      twoRootR ρ

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.twoRootR_gap_bound
statement:
theorem twoRootR_gap_bound (ρ : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) :
    (4 + Real.sqrt (2 : ℝ) - 3 * Real.sqrt 3) / 4 * ρ ^ 2 ≤
      twoRootR ρ - Real.sqrt 3 / 2 + 1 - Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.twoRootR_gap_pos
statement:
theorem twoRootR_gap_pos (ρ : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) :
    0 < twoRootR ρ - Real.sqrt 3 / 2 + 1 - Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.two_gap_coefficient_pos
statement: theorem two_gap_coefficient_pos : 0 < (4 + Real.sqrt (2 : ℝ) - 3 * Real.sqrt 3) / 4

name: Hellinger.BentEstimates.two_root_pair
statement:
theorem two_root_pair (ρ : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) :
    2 * Real.sqrt (3 - ρ ^ 2) ≤
      Real.sqrt (3 + ρ ^ 2 - 4 * ρ) + Real.sqrt (3 + ρ ^ 2 + 4 * ρ)

name: Hellinger.UniformChannel.apply_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem apply_mem_Icc (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (x : Ω) :
    K.apply f x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1

name: Hellinger.UniformChannel.apply_neg
statement:
theorem apply_neg (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    K.apply (fun x => -f x) = fun x => -K.apply f x

name: Hellinger.UniformChannel.concave_mean_expands
statement:
theorem concave_mean_expands (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (r : ℝ → ℝ) (hr : ConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) r)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => r (f x)) ≤ mean (fun x => r (K.apply f x))

name: Hellinger.UniformChannel.convex_mean_contracts
statement:
theorem convex_mean_contracts (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (Φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hΦ : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) Φ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => Φ (K.apply f x)) ≤ mean (fun x => Φ (f x))

name: Hellinger.UniformChannel.mean_apply
statement:
theorem mean_apply (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    mean (K.apply f) = mean f

name: Hellinger.UniformChannel.sum_apply
statement:
theorem sum_apply (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    ∑ x, K.apply f x = ∑ x, f x

name: Hellinger.mean_const
statement:
theorem mean_const {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (a : ℝ) :
    mean (fun _ : Ω => a) = a

name: Hellinger.mean_neg
statement:
theorem mean_neg {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    mean (fun x => -f x) = -mean f

name: Hellinger.objective_channel_le
statement:
theorem objective_channel_le {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    objective (K.apply f) ≤ objective f

name: Hellinger.objective_neg
statement:
theorem objective_neg {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    objective (fun x => -f x) = objective f

name: Hellinger.root_concave
statement: theorem root_concave : ConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) root

name: Hellinger.root_neg
statement: theorem root_neg (t : ℝ) : root (-t) = root t

name: Hellinger.UniformChannel.product_apply
statement:
theorem product_apply (K : ∀ i, UniformChannel (Ω i)) (f : ∀ i, Ω i → ℝ) (x : ∀ i, Ω i) :
    (product K).apply (fun y => ∏ i, f i (y i)) x = ∏ i, (K i).apply (f i) (x i)

name: Hellinger.antipodal_mean_zero
statement:
theorem antipodal_mean_zero (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f (antipode n x) = -f x) : mean f = 0

name: Hellinger.boolSign_neg
statement: theorem boolSign_neg (b : Bool) : boolSign (!b) = -boolSign b

name: Hellinger.boolSign_sq
statement: theorem boolSign_sq (b : Bool) : boolSign b ^ 2 = 1

name: Hellinger.bsc_apply_one
statement:
theorem bsc_apply_one (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Bool) :
    (bsc ρ hρ).apply (fun _ => 1) x = 1

name: Hellinger.bsc_apply_sign
statement:
theorem bsc_apply_sign (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Bool) :
    (bsc ρ hρ).apply boolSign x = ρ * boolSign x

name: Hellinger.bsc_dictator_equality
statement:
theorem bsc_dictator_equality (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (fun x => boolSign (x i))) =
      1 - Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.bsc_signed_dictator_equality
statement:
theorem bsc_signed_dictator_equality (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (negative : Bool)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply
      (fun x => if negative then -boolSign (x i) else boolSign (x i))) =
      1 - Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.character_eigenfunction
statement:
theorem character_eigenfunction (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Fin n → Bool) :
    (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (character n S) x = ρ ^ S.card * character n S x

name: Hellinger.mean_eq_zero_of_sign_reversing
statement:
theorem mean_eq_zero_of_sign_reversing {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (e : Ω ≃ Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f (e x) = - f x) : mean f = 0

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.abs_constant_of_flip_squared_gram
statement:
theorem abs_constant_of_flip_squared_gram (g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hgram : ∀ x i,
      (1 + (g (Function.update x i (!(x i))) + g x) / 2) ^ 2 *
          (1 - g (Function.update x i (!(x i)))) * (1 - g x) =
        (1 - (g (Function.update x i (!(x i))) + g x) / 2) ^ 2 *
          (1 + g (Function.update x i (!(x i)))) * (1 + g x)) :
    ∀ x y, |g x| = |g y|

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.abs_constant_of_normalized_edge_gram
statement:
theorem abs_constant_of_normalized_edge_gram (g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ x, -1 < g x ∧ g x < 1)
    (hgram : ∀ x i,
      (1 + (g (Function.update x i (!(x i))) + g x) / 2) /
          Real.sqrt ((1 + g (Function.update x i (!(x i)))) * (1 + g x)) =
        (1 - (g (Function.update x i (!(x i))) + g x) / 2) /
          Real.sqrt ((1 - g (Function.update x i (!(x i)))) * (1 - g x))) :
    ∀ x y, |g x| = |g y|

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.abs_constant_of_update_squared_gram
statement:
theorem abs_constant_of_update_squared_gram (g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hgram : ∀ x i b,
      (1 + (g (Function.update x i b) + g x) / 2) ^ 2 *
          (1 - g (Function.update x i b)) * (1 - g x) =
        (1 - (g (Function.update x i b) + g x) / 2) ^ 2 *
          (1 + g (Function.update x i b)) * (1 + g x)) :
    ∀ x y, |g x| = |g y|

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.abs_eq_of_normalized_gram
statement:
theorem abs_eq_of_normalized_gram (p q : ℝ)
    (hp_lower : -1 < p) (hp_upper : p < 1)
    (hq_lower : -1 < q) (hq_upper : q < 1)
    (hgram :
      (1 + (p + q) / 2) / Real.sqrt ((1 + p) * (1 + q)) =
        (1 - (p + q) / 2) / Real.sqrt ((1 - p) * (1 - q))) :
    |p| = |q|

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.all_positive_square
statement:
lemma all_positive_square (a : ι → ℝ)
    (hbool : ∀ x : ι → ℝ, IsSignVector x → (∑ i, a i * x i) ^ 2 = 1) :
    (∑ i, a i) ^ 2 = 1

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.boolean_linear_coefficients
statement:
theorem boolean_linear_coefficients (a : ι → ℝ)
    (hbool : ∀ x : ι → ℝ, IsSignVector x → (∑ i, a i * x i) ^ 2 = 1) :
    ∃ i, (a i = 1 ∨ a i = -1) ∧ ∀ j, j ≠ i → a j = 0

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.boolean_linear_is_signed_coordinate
statement:
theorem boolean_linear_is_signed_coordinate (a : ι → ℝ)
    (hbool : ∀ x : ι → ℝ, IsSignVector x → (∑ i, a i * x i) ^ 2 = 1) :
    ∃ i, (a i = 1 ∨ a i = -1) ∧
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → a j = 0) ∧
      ∀ x : ι → ℝ, (∑ j, a j * x j) = a i * x i

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.boolean_linear_unique_nonzero
statement:
theorem boolean_linear_unique_nonzero (a : ι → ℝ)
    (hbool : ∀ x : ι → ℝ, IsSignVector x → (∑ i, a i * x i) ^ 2 = 1) :
    ∃! i, a i ≠ 0

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.coefficient_eq_zero_of_noise_parseval_equality
statement:
theorem coefficient_eq_zero_of_noise_parseval_equality {s : Finset ι}
    (degree : ι → ℕ) (coeff : ι → ℝ) (rho : ℝ)
    (hrho_pos : 0 < rho) (hrho_lt_one : rho < 1)
    (hdegree : ∀ i ∈ s, 1 ≤ degree i)
    (hnorm : (∑ i ∈ s, (coeff i) ^ 2) = 1)
    (hnoise : (∑ i ∈ s, rho ^ (2 * degree i) * (coeff i) ^ 2) = rho ^ 2)
    {j : ι} (hj : j ∈ s) (hhigh : 1 < degree j) :
    coeff j = 0

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.coefficient_mul_eq_zero_of_boolean_linear
statement:
theorem coefficient_mul_eq_zero_of_boolean_linear (a : ι → ℝ)
    (hbool : ∀ x : ι → ℝ, IsSignVector x → (∑ i, a i * x i) ^ 2 = 1)
    (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    a i * a j = 0

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.constant_of_update_invariant
statement:
theorem constant_of_update_invariant {β γ : Type*} (g : (ι → β) → γ)
    (hupdate : ∀ x i b, g (Function.update x i b) = g x) :
    ∀ x y, g x = g y

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.eq_or_eq_neg_of_squared_gram
statement:
theorem eq_or_eq_neg_of_squared_gram (p q : ℝ)
    (h : (1 + (p + q) / 2) ^ 2 * (1 - p) * (1 - q) =
      (1 - (p + q) / 2) ^ 2 * (1 + p) * (1 + q)) :
    p = q ∨ p = -q

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.squared_gram_of_normalized_gram
statement:
theorem squared_gram_of_normalized_gram (p q : ℝ)
    (hp_lower : -1 < p) (hp_upper : p < 1)
    (hq_lower : -1 < q) (hq_upper : q < 1)
    (hgram :
      (1 + (p + q) / 2) / Real.sqrt ((1 + p) * (1 + q)) =
        (1 - (p + q) / 2) / Real.sqrt ((1 - p) * (1 - q))) :
    (1 + (p + q) / 2) ^ 2 * (1 - p) * (1 - q) =
      (1 - (p + q) / 2) ^ 2 * (1 + p) * (1 + q)

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.sum_double_flip
statement:
lemma sum_double_flip (a : ι → ℝ) (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (∑ k, a k * (if k = i ∨ k = j then (-1 : ℝ) else 1)) =
      (∑ k, a k) - 2 * a i - 2 * a j

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.sum_single_flip
statement:
lemma sum_single_flip (a : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) :
    (∑ k, a k * (if k = i then (-1 : ℝ) else 1)) =
      (∑ k, a k) - 2 * a i

name: Hellinger.Rigidity.weight_eq_zero_of_strict_multiplier
statement:
theorem weight_eq_zero_of_strict_multiplier {s : Finset ι}
    (a w : ι → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i)
    (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, a i ≤ c)
    (heq : (∑ i ∈ s, a i * w i) = c * ∑ i ∈ s, w i)
    {j : ι} (hj : j ∈ s) (hstrict : a j < c) :
    w j = 0

name: Hellinger.Fourier.autocorrelation_formula
statement:
theorem autocorrelation_formula {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ) (v : Cube n) :
    autocorrelation f v = ∑ s, walsh f s ^ 2 * phase s v

name: Hellinger.Fourier.boolean_parseval
statement:
theorem boolean_parseval {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) :
    (∑ s, walsh f s ^ 2) = 1

name: Hellinger.Fourier.coordinate_orthogonality
statement:
theorem coordinate_orthogonality (a b : Bool) :
    (∑ x : Bool, boolSign (a && x) * boolSign (b && x)) =
      if a = b then (2 : ℝ) else 0

name: Hellinger.Fourier.coordinate_phase_translate
statement:
theorem coordinate_phase_translate (s x v : Bool) :
    boolSign (s && Bool.xor x v) =
      boolSign (s && x) * boolSign (s && v)

name: Hellinger.Fourier.cube_card
statement: theorem cube_card (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Cube n) = 2 ^ n

name: Hellinger.Fourier.inversion
statement:
theorem inversion {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    f x = ∑ s, walsh f s * phase s x

name: Hellinger.Fourier.mean_add
statement:
theorem mean_add {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    mean (fun x => f x + g x) = mean f + mean g

name: Hellinger.Fourier.mean_const_mul
statement:
theorem mean_const_mul {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    mean (fun x => c * f x) = c * mean f

name: Hellinger.Fourier.mean_le_mean
statement:
theorem mean_le_mean {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f g : Ω → ℝ)
    (hfg : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) : mean f ≤ mean g

name: Hellinger.Fourier.mean_mul_const
statement:
theorem mean_mul_const {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    mean (fun x => f x * c) = mean f * c

name: Hellinger.Fourier.mean_mul_expansion
statement:
theorem mean_mul_expansion {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ) (a : Cube n → ℝ) :
    mean (fun x => f x * (∑ s, a s * phase s x)) =
      ∑ s, a s * walsh f s

name: Hellinger.Fourier.mean_nonneg
statement:
theorem mean_nonneg {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) : 0 ≤ mean f

name: Hellinger.Fourier.mean_sq_le_mean_mul
statement:
theorem mean_sq_le_mean_mul {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (r f g : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x)
    (he : ∀ x, r x ^ 2 = f x * g x) :
    mean r ^ 2 ≤ mean f * mean g

name: Hellinger.Fourier.mean_sub
statement:
theorem mean_sub {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    mean (fun x => f x - g x) = mean f - mean g

name: Hellinger.Fourier.mean_sum
statement:
theorem mean_sum {Ω ι : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype ι] (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    mean (fun x => ∑ i, f i x) = ∑ i, mean (f i)

name: Hellinger.Fourier.mean_translate
statement:
theorem mean_translate {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ) (v : Cube n) :
    mean (fun x => f (translate v x)) = mean f

name: Hellinger.Fourier.mean_translated_product
statement:
theorem mean_translated_product {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ) (u v : Cube n) :
    mean (fun x => f (translate u x) * f (translate v x)) =
      autocorrelation f (translate v u)

name: Hellinger.Fourier.noise_expansion
statement:
theorem noise_expansion {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Cube n) :
    (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x =
      ∑ s, (ρ ^ degree s * walsh f s) * phase s x

name: Hellinger.Fourier.noise_phase
statement:
theorem noise_phase {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Cube n) :
    (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (phase s) x = ρ ^ degree s * phase s x

name: Hellinger.Fourier.noise_second_moment
statement:
theorem noise_second_moment {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 2) =
      ∑ s, ρ ^ (2 * degree s) * walsh f s ^ 2

name: Hellinger.Fourier.orthogonality
statement:
theorem orthogonality {n : ℕ} (s t : Cube n) :
    mean (fun x => phase s x * phase t x) = if s = t then 1 else 0

name: Hellinger.Fourier.parseval
statement:
theorem parseval {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ) :
    mean (fun x => f x ^ 2) = ∑ s, walsh f s ^ 2

name: Hellinger.Fourier.phase_abs
statement: theorem phase_abs {n : ℕ} (s x : Cube n) : |phase s x| = 1

name: Hellinger.Fourier.phase_character
statement:
theorem phase_character {n : ℕ} (s x : Cube n) :
    phase s x = character n (support s) x

name: Hellinger.Fourier.phase_sq
statement: theorem phase_sq {n : ℕ} (s x : Cube n) : phase s x ^ 2 = 1

name: Hellinger.Fourier.phase_symm
statement: theorem phase_symm {n : ℕ} (s x : Cube n) : phase s x = phase x s

name: Hellinger.Fourier.phase_translate
statement:
theorem phase_translate {n : ℕ} (s v x : Cube n) :
    phase s (translate v x) = phase s x * phase s v

name: Hellinger.Fourier.phase_zero
statement: theorem phase_zero {n : ℕ} (x : Cube n) : phase (fun _ => false) x = 1

name: Hellinger.Fourier.pow_degree
statement:
theorem pow_degree {n : ℕ} (t : ℝ) (s : Cube n) :
    t ^ degree s = ∏ i, if s i = true then t else 1

name: Hellinger.Fourier.sum_phase
statement:
theorem sum_phase {n : ℕ} (v : Cube n) :
    (∑ s : Cube n, phase s v) =
      if v = (fun _ => false) then (2 : ℝ) ^ n else 0

name: Hellinger.Fourier.sum_phase_mul
statement:
theorem sum_phase_mul {n : ℕ} (s t : Cube n) :
    (∑ x, phase s x * phase t x) =
      if s = t then (2 : ℝ) ^ n else 0

name: Hellinger.Fourier.sum_pow_degree
statement:
theorem sum_pow_degree (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (∑ s : Cube n, t ^ degree s) = (1 + t) ^ n

name: Hellinger.Fourier.translate_comp
statement:
theorem translate_comp {n : ℕ} (u v x : Cube n) :
    translate u (translate v x) = translate (translate u v) x

name: Hellinger.Fourier.translate_involutive
statement:
theorem translate_involutive {n : ℕ} (v : Cube n) :
    Function.Involutive (translate v)

name: Hellinger.Fourier.translate_twice
statement:
theorem translate_twice {n : ℕ} (v x : Cube n) :
    translate v (translate v x) = x

name: Hellinger.Fourier.translate_unit
statement:
theorem translate_unit {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (x : Cube n) :
    translate (unit i) x = Function.update x i (!(x i))

name: Hellinger.Fourier.unit_ne_zero
statement: theorem unit_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : unit i ≠ (fun _ => false)

name: Hellinger.Fourier.unit_pair_ne_zero
statement:
theorem unit_pair_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    translate (unit j) (unit i) ≠ (fun _ => false)

name: Hellinger.Fourier.walsh_expansion
statement:
theorem walsh_expansion {n : ℕ} (a : Cube n → ℝ) (s : Cube n) :
    walsh (fun x => ∑ t, a t * phase t x) s = a s

name: Hellinger.Fourier.walsh_noise
statement:
theorem walsh_noise {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (s : Cube n) :
    walsh ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) s = ρ ^ degree s * walsh f s

name: Hellinger.Fourier.walsh_phase
statement:
theorem walsh_phase {n : ℕ} (s t : Cube n) :
    walsh (phase s) t = if s = t then 1 else 0

name: Hellinger.Fourier.walsh_zero
statement:
theorem walsh_zero {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ) :
    walsh f (fun _ => false) = mean f

name: Hellinger.Flatness.amplitude_nonneg
statement: theorem amplitude_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ amplitude n

name: Hellinger.Flatness.amplitude_sq
statement: theorem amplitude_sq (n : ℕ) : amplitude n ^ 2 = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹

name: Hellinger.Flatness.autocorrelation_eq
statement:
theorem autocorrelation_eq {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ} (hb : IsBent f) (v : Cube n) :
    autocorrelation f v = if v = (fun _ => false) then 1 else 0

name: Hellinger.Flatness.autocorrelation_zero
statement:
theorem autocorrelation_zero {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ} (hb : IsBent f)
    (v : Cube n) (hv : v ≠ (fun _ => false)) : autocorrelation f v = 0

name: Hellinger.Flatness.isBent_iff_abs
statement:
theorem isBent_iff_abs {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ) :
    IsBent f ↔ ∀ s, |walsh f s| = amplitude n

name: Hellinger.Flatness.mean_sq
statement:
theorem mean_sq {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ} (hb : IsBent f) :
    mean f ^ 2 = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹

name: Hellinger.Flatness.mean_sqrt_interpolation
statement:
theorem mean_sqrt_interpolation {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (s : Ω → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ x, 0 ≤ s x) :
    mean s ^ 3 ≤ mean (fun x => Real.sqrt (s x)) ^ 2 * mean (fun x => s x ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.Flatness.noise_abs_le
statement:
theorem noise_abs_le {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ} (hb : IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Cube n) :
    |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x| ≤ amplitude n * (1 + ρ) ^ n

name: Hellinger.Flatness.noise_second_moment
statement:
theorem noise_second_moment {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ} (hb : IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 2) =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * (1 + ρ ^ 2) ^ n

name: Hellinger.Flatness.noisy_mean_sq
statement:
theorem noisy_mean_sq {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ} (hb : IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) ^ 2 = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹

name: Hellinger.Flatness.sensitivityIndicator_eq_ite
statement:
theorem sensitivityIndicator_eq_ite {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (i : Fin n) (x : Cube n) :
    sensitivityIndicator f i x =
      if f (Function.update x i (!(x i))) ≠ f x then 1 else 0

name: Hellinger.Flatness.sensitivityIndicator_mean
statement:
theorem sensitivityIndicator_mean {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ}
    (hb : IsBent f) (i : Fin n) : mean (sensitivityIndicator f i) = 1 / 2

name: Hellinger.Flatness.sensitivityIndicator_pair_mean
statement:
theorem sensitivityIndicator_pair_mean {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : IsBent f)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    mean (fun x => sensitivityIndicator f i x * sensitivityIndicator f j x) = 1 / 4

name: Hellinger.Flatness.sensitivityIndicator_sq
Hellinger.Flatness.sensitivityIndicator_zero_or_one
Hellinger.Flatness.sensitivity_eq_card
statement:
theorem sensitivity_eq_card {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (x : Cube n) :
    sensitivity f x =
      ((Finset.univ.filter
        (fun i => f (Function.update x i (!(x i))) ≠ f x)).card : ℝ)

name: Hellinger.Flatness.sensitivity_mean
statement:
theorem sensitivity_mean {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ} (hb : IsBent f) :
    mean (sensitivity f) = (n : ℝ) / 2

name: Hellinger.Flatness.sensitivity_nonneg
statement:
theorem sensitivity_nonneg {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (x : Cube n) : 0 ≤ sensitivity f x

name: Hellinger.Flatness.sensitivity_second_moment
Hellinger.Flatness.sensitivity_sqrt_mean_lower
statement:
theorem sensitivity_sqrt_mean_lower {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : IsBent f) :
    (n : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (2 * (n + 1)) ≤
      mean (fun x => Real.sqrt (sensitivity f x))

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.bent_high_noise_hellinger
statement:
theorem bent_high_noise_hellinger {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρ₁ : ρ ≤ 3 / 10) :
    objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) ≤ 1 - Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.bent_high_noise_hellinger_strict
statement:
theorem bent_high_noise_hellinger_strict {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρ₁ : ρ ≤ 3 / 10) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) :
    objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.bent_high_noise_quadratic_bound
statement:
theorem bent_high_noise_quadratic_bound {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρ₁ : ρ ≤ 3 / 10) :
    objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) ≤ ρ ^ 2 / 2

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.bent_middle_hellinger
statement:
theorem bent_middle_hellinger {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n)
    (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = 1 ∨ f x = -1)
    (hb : Flatness.IsBent f) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hρ₀ : 3 / 10 ≤ ρ) (hρ₁ : ρ ≤ 1 - 2 / (3 * (n : ℝ))) :
    objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) ≤ 1 - Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.bent_middle_hellinger_strict
statement:
theorem bent_middle_hellinger_strict {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n)
    (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = 1 ∨ f x = -1)
    (hb : Flatness.IsBent f) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hρ₀ : 3 / 10 ≤ ρ) (hρ₁ : ρ ≤ 1 - 2 / (3 * (n : ℝ))) :
    objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.dimension_variance_coefficient
statement:
theorem dimension_variance_coefficient (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    (n : ℝ) * (109 / 200 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) / 2 ≤ 109 ^ 3 / 4000000

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.exp_neg_seventeen_twentyseven_lt
statement:
theorem exp_neg_seventeen_twentyseven_lt :
    Real.exp (-(17 : ℝ) / 27) < 27 / 50

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.high_noise_constant_lt
statement:
theorem high_noise_constant_lt :
    (109 ^ 3 / 4000000 : ℝ) < root ((169 / 200 : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ 3

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.high_noise_posterior_bound
statement:
theorem high_noise_posterior_bound {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    {f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ} (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρ₁ : ρ ≤ 3 / 10)
    (x : Fourier.Cube n) :
    |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x| ≤ (169 / 200 : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.high_noise_variance
statement:
theorem high_noise_variance (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ₀ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ₁ : ρ ≤ 3 / 10) :
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * ((1 + ρ ^ 2) ^ n - 1) ≤
      (109 ^ 3 / 4000000 : ℝ) * ρ ^ 2

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.mean_curvature_bound
statement:
theorem mean_curvature_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (u : ι → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hM₀ : 0 ≤ M) (hM₁ : M < 1)
    (hu : ∀ i, u i ∈ Set.Icc (-M) M) :
    objective u ≤ (mean (fun i => (u i) ^ 2) - (mean u) ^ 2) /
      (2 * root M ^ 3)

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.mean_root_lower
statement:
theorem mean_root_lower {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (u : ι → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, u i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    1 - mean (fun i => (u i) ^ 2) ≤ mean (fun i => root (u i))

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.middle_noise_second_moment
statement:
theorem middle_noise_second_moment (n : ℕ) (hn : 6 ≤ n) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ₀ : 3 / 10 ≤ ρ) (hρ₁ : ρ ≤ 1 - 2 / (3 * (n : ℝ))) :
    ((1 + ρ ^ 2) / 2) ^ n ≤ 1 - Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.middle_scalar
statement:
theorem middle_scalar (n : ℕ) (hn : 6 ≤ n) (c : ℝ)
    (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c) (hc₁ : c ≤ 24 / 25)
    (hscale : 17 / 27 ≤ (n : ℝ) * c ^ 2 / 2) :
    (1 - c ^ 2 / 2) ^ n ≤ 1 - c

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.middle_six_polynomial
statement:
theorem middle_six_polynomial (c : ℝ) (hc₀ : 23 / 50 ≤ c) (hc₁ : c ≤ 24 / 25) :
    (1 - c ^ 2 / 2) ^ 6 ≤ 1 - c - 1 / 100

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.root_derivative_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem root_derivative_hasDerivAt (x : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 2 < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => -y / root y) (-1 / root x ^ 3) x

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.root_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem root_hasDerivAt (x : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 2 < 1) :
    HasDerivAt root (-x / root x) x

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.root_quadratic_convex
statement:
theorem root_quadratic_convex (M : ℝ) (hM₀ : 0 ≤ M) (hM₁ : M < 1) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Icc (-M) M)
      (fun x => root x + (1 / (2 * root M ^ 3)) * x ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.BentLarge.weighted_curvature_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_curvature_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (w u : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hsum : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (M : ℝ) (hM₀ : 0 ≤ M) (hM₁ : M < 1)
    (hu : ∀ i, u i ∈ Set.Icc (-M) M) :
    root (∑ i, w i * u i) - ∑ i, w i * root (u i) ≤
      ((∑ i, w i * (u i) ^ 2) - (∑ i, w i * u i) ^ 2) /
        (2 * root M ^ 3)

name: Hellinger.BentLow.agreement_lower
statement:
theorem agreement_lower {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Cube n) :
    ((1 + ρ) / 2) ^ n ≤ 1 - mismatchProbability f ρ hρ x

name: Hellinger.BentLow.agreement_nonneg
statement:
theorem agreement_nonneg {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (x y : Cube n) : 0 ≤ 1 - disagreement f x y

name: Hellinger.BentLow.bent_large_hellinger
statement:
theorem bent_large_hellinger {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n)
    {f : Cube n → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) ≤ 1 - root ρ ∧
      (0 < ρ → objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - root ρ)

name: Hellinger.BentLow.bent_low_noise_hellinger_strict
statement:
theorem bent_low_noise_hellinger_strict {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n)
    {f : Cube n → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hlo : 1 - 2 / (3 * (n : ℝ)) ≤ ρ) :
    objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - root ρ

name: Hellinger.BentLow.bent_low_noise_root_mean
statement:
theorem bent_low_noise_root_mean {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n)
    {f : Cube n → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hlo : 1 - 2 / (3 * (n : ℝ)) ≤ ρ) :
    root ρ ≤ mean (fun x => root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x))

name: Hellinger.BentLow.cube_weight_neighbor
statement:
theorem cube_weight_neighbor {n : ℕ} (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (x : Cube n) (i : Fin n) :
    (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight x (neighbor x i) =
      ((1 - ρ) / 2) * ((1 + ρ) / 2) ^ (n - 1)

name: Hellinger.BentLow.cube_weight_self
statement:
theorem cube_weight_self (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (x : Cube n) : (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight x x = ((1 + ρ) / 2) ^ n

name: Hellinger.BentLow.disagreement_nonneg
statement:
theorem disagreement_nonneg {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (x y : Cube n) : 0 ≤ disagreement f x y

name: Hellinger.BentLow.low_noise_dimension_factor
statement:
theorem low_noise_dimension_factor (n : ℕ) (hn : 6 ≤ n) :
    1 ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)))

name: Hellinger.BentLow.low_noise_power_lower
statement:
theorem low_noise_power_lower (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hlo : 1 - 2 / (3 * (n : ℝ)) ≤ ρ) :
    (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ ((1 + ρ) / 2) ^ (n - 1)

name: Hellinger.BentLow.mismatch_formula
statement:
theorem mismatch_formula {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Cube n) :
    mismatchProbability f ρ hρ x = (1 - f x * (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x) / 2

name: Hellinger.BentLow.mismatch_lower
statement:
theorem mismatch_lower {n : ℕ} {f : Cube n → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Cube n) :
    ((1 - ρ) / 2) * ((1 + ρ) / 2) ^ (n - 1) * Flatness.sensitivity f x ≤
      mismatchProbability f ρ hρ x

name: Hellinger.BentLow.neighbor_injective
statement: theorem neighbor_injective {n : ℕ} (x : Cube n) : Function.Injective (neighbor x)

name: Hellinger.BentLow.posterior_root_lower
statement:
theorem posterior_root_lower {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {f : Cube n → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Cube n) :
    root ρ * ((1 + ρ) / 2) ^ (n - 1) * Real.sqrt (Flatness.sensitivity f x) ≤
      root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x)

name: Hellinger.BentLow.posterior_root_mean_lower
statement:
theorem posterior_root_mean_lower {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {f : Cube n → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    root ρ * ((1 + ρ) / 2) ^ (n - 1) *
      mean (fun x => Real.sqrt (Flatness.sensitivity f x)) ≤
        mean (fun x => root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x))

name: Hellinger.BentFour.bent_face_product
statement:
theorem bent_face_product (f : Cube 4 → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hb : Flatness.IsBent f) (i : Fin 4) (b : Bool) :
    ∏ x ∈ face i b, f x = 1

name: Hellinger.BentFour.bent_face_sum
statement:
theorem bent_face_sum (f : Cube 4 → ℝ) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f) (i : Fin 4) (b : Bool) :
    (∑ x ∈ face i b, f x) = -4 ∨ (∑ x ∈ face i b, f x) = 0 ∨
      (∑ x ∈ face i b, f x) = 4

name: Hellinger.BentFour.bent_quadratic_representation
statement:
theorem bent_quadratic_representation (f : Cube 4 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f) :
    f = quadraticPhase (constantTerm f) (linearTerms f) (mixedTerms f)

name: Hellinger.BentFour.boolean_product_of_eight_sum
statement:
theorem boolean_product_of_eight_sum {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hcard : s.card = 8)
    (hsum : (∑ x ∈ s, f x) = -4 ∨ (∑ x ∈ s, f x) = 0 ∨ (∑ x ∈ s, f x) = 4) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, f x = 1

name: Hellinger.BentFour.face_card
statement: theorem face_card (i : Fin 4) (b : Bool) : (face i b).card = 8

name: Hellinger.BentFour.face_sum
statement:
theorem face_sum (f : Cube 4 → ℝ) (i : Fin 4) (b : Bool) :
    (∑ x ∈ face i b, f x) = 8 * (mean f + boolSign b * walsh f (unit i))

name: Hellinger.BentFour.flat_four_coefficient
statement:
theorem flat_four_coefficient (f : Cube 4 → ℝ) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f) (s : Cube 4) :
    walsh f s = -1 / 4 ∨ walsh f s = 1 / 4

name: Hellinger.BentFour.phase_unit
statement: theorem phase_unit (i : Fin 4) (x : Cube 4) : phase (unit i) x = boolSign (x i)

name: Hellinger.BentFour.prod_four_bits
statement:
theorem prod_four_bits {R : Type*} [CommMonoid R] (F : Cube 4 → R) :
    (∏ x, F x) =
      ∏ a : Bool, ∏ b : Bool, ∏ c : Bool, ∏ d : Bool, F ![a, b, c, d]

name: Hellinger.BentFour.quadraticPhase_sq
statement:
theorem quadraticPhase_sq (c : ℝ) (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hc : c ^ 2 = 1) (hl : ∀ i, l i ^ 2 = 1) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1) (x : Cube 4) :
    quadraticPhase c l e x ^ 2 = 1

name: Hellinger.BentFour.quadratic_bent_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem quadratic_bent_nondegenerate (c : ℝ) (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hc : c ^ 2 = 1) (hl : ∀ i, l i ^ 2 = 1) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (hb : Flatness.IsBent (quadraticPhase c l e)) : EdgeNondegenerate e

name: Hellinger.BentFour.quadratic_polar
statement:
theorem quadratic_polar (c : ℝ) (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hc : c ^ 2 = 1) (hl : ∀ i, l i ^ 2 = 1) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (s x : Cube 4) :
    quadraticPhase c l e x * quadraticPhase c l e (translate s x) =
      c * quadraticPhase c l e s * signCharacter (edgeAction e s) x

name: Hellinger.BentFour.quadratic_weighted_derivative
statement:
theorem quadratic_weighted_derivative (c : ℝ) (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hc : c ^ 2 = 1) (hl : ∀ i, l i ^ 2 = 1) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (s : Cube 4) :
    (∑ x : Cube 4, ρ ^ (degree x + degree (translate s x)) *
      (quadraticPhase c l e x * quadraticPhase c l e (translate s x))) ^ 2 =
        noiseDerivativeSum e ρ s ^ 2

name: Hellinger.BentFour.signCharacter_sum
statement:
theorem signCharacter_sum (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : Cube 4, signCharacter a x) = ∏ i, (1 + a i)

name: Hellinger.BentFour.sum_four_bits
statement:
theorem sum_four_bits {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] (F : Cube 4 → R) :
    (∑ x, F x) =
      ∑ a : Bool, ∑ b : Bool, ∑ c : Bool, ∑ d : Bool, F ![a, b, c, d]

name: Hellinger.BentFour.weighted_character_sum
statement:
theorem weighted_character_sum (a : Fin 4 → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (s : Cube 4) :
    (∑ x : Cube 4, ρ ^ (degree x + degree (translate s x)) * signCharacter a x) =
      ∏ i, if s i then ρ * (1 + a i) else 1 + ρ ^ 2 * a i

name: Hellinger.BentFourGraphs.derivative_moment_classification
statement:
theorem derivative_moment_classification (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1) (hnd : EdgeNondegenerate e) (ρ : ℝ) :
    ∃ d : ℝ, 2 ≤ d ∧ (∑ s : Cube 4, noiseDerivativeSum e ρ s ^ 2) =
      256 * BentEstimates.fourthMomentExpression d (ρ ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.BentFourGraphs.derivative_moment_upper
statement:
theorem derivative_moment_upper (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1) (hnd : EdgeNondegenerate e) (ρ : ℝ) :
    (∑ s : Cube 4, noiseDerivativeSum e ρ s ^ 2) / 256 ≤
      BentEstimates.bentH (ρ ^ 2) ^ 2 / 256

name: Hellinger.FourierProducts.noise_fourth_moment
statement:
theorem noise_fourth_moment {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 4) =
      ∑ s, (∑ a, (ρ ^ degree a * walsh f a) *
        (ρ ^ degree (translate s a) * walsh f (translate s a))) ^ 2

name: Hellinger.FourierProducts.phase_product
statement:
theorem phase_product {n : ℕ} (s a x : Cube n) :
    phase s x * phase a x = phase (translate s a) x

name: Hellinger.FourierProducts.walsh_involution
statement:
theorem walsh_involution {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    walsh (walsh f) x = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * f x

name: Hellinger.FourierProducts.walsh_modulate
statement:
theorem walsh_modulate {n : ℕ} (g : Cube n → ℝ) (s a : Cube n) :
    walsh (fun x => g x * phase s x) a = walsh g (translate s a)

name: Hellinger.FourierProducts.walsh_mul
statement:
theorem walsh_mul {n : ℕ} (f g : Cube n → ℝ) (s : Cube n) :
    walsh (fun x => f x * g x) s =
      ∑ a, walsh f a * walsh g (translate s a)

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.bent_four_sensitivity_mean
statement:
theorem bent_four_sensitivity_mean (f : Cube 4 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f) :
    mean (fun x => Real.sqrt (Flatness.sensitivity f x)) =
      (3 + 3 * Real.sqrt 2 + 2 * Real.sqrt 3) / 8

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.coefficient_squares
statement:
theorem coefficient_squares (f : Cube 4 → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) :
    constantTerm f ^ 2 = 1 ∧ (∀ i, linearTerms f i ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ i, mixedTerms f i ^ 2 = 1)

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.degree_eq_sum
statement: theorem degree_eq_sum (x : Cube 4) : (degree x : ℝ) = ∑ i, if x i then (1 : ℝ) else 0

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.dual_bent
statement:
theorem dual_bent (f : Cube 4 → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) :
    Flatness.IsBent (dual f)

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.dual_boolean
statement:
theorem dual_boolean (f : Cube 4 → ℝ) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f) :
    ∀ s, dual f s = -1 ∨ dual f s = 1

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.dual_walsh
statement: theorem dual_walsh (f : Cube 4 → ℝ) (x : Cube 4) : walsh (dual f) x = f x / 4

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.edgeAction_sq
statement:
theorem edgeAction_sq (e : Fin 6 → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (x : Cube 4) (i : Fin 4) : edgeAction e x i ^ 2 = 1

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.edgeAction_translate
statement:
theorem edgeAction_translate (e : Fin 6 → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (s x : Cube 4) (i : Fin 4) :
    edgeAction e (translate s x) i = edgeAction e x i * edgeAction e s i

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.edgeAction_unit_character
statement:
theorem edgeAction_unit_character (e : Fin 6 → ℝ) (x : Cube 4) (i : Fin 4) :
    signCharacter (edgeAction e (unit i)) x = edgeAction e x i

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.edgeBits_injective
statement:
theorem edgeBits_injective (e : Fin 6 → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (hnd : EdgeNondegenerate e) : Function.Injective (edgeBits e)

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.edgeBits_sign
statement:
theorem edgeBits_sign (e : Fin 6 → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (x : Cube 4) (i : Fin 4) : boolSign (edgeBits e x i) = edgeAction e x i

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.edge_mean_invariant
statement:
theorem edge_mean_invariant (e : Fin 6 → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (hnd : EdgeNondegenerate e) (F : Cube 4 → ℝ) :
    mean (fun x => F (edgeBits e x)) = mean F

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.linearBits_sign
statement:
theorem linearBits_sign (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hl : ∀ i, l i ^ 2 = 1) (i : Fin 4) :
    boolSign (linearBits l i) = l i

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.quadratic_coordinate_derivative
statement:
theorem quadratic_coordinate_derivative (c : ℝ) (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hc : c ^ 2 = 1) (hl : ∀ i, l i ^ 2 = 1) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (x : Cube 4) (i : Fin 4) :
    quadraticPhase c l e x * quadraticPhase c l e (translate (unit i) x) =
      l i * edgeAction e x i

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.quadratic_sensitivity
statement:
theorem quadratic_sensitivity (c : ℝ) (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hc : c ^ 2 = 1) (hl : ∀ i, l i ^ 2 = 1) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (x : Cube 4) :
    Flatness.sensitivity (quadraticPhase c l e) x =
      (degree (translate (linearBits l) (edgeBits e x)) : ℝ)

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.quadratic_sensitivity_distribution
statement:
theorem quadratic_sensitivity_distribution (c : ℝ) (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hc : c ^ 2 = 1) (hl : ∀ i, l i ^ 2 = 1) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1)
    (hnd : EdgeNondegenerate e) (Φ : ℝ → ℝ) :
    mean (fun x => Φ (Flatness.sensitivity (quadraticPhase c l e) x)) =
      mean (fun x : Cube 4 => Φ (degree x))

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.quadratic_unit
statement:
theorem quadratic_unit (c : ℝ) (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (e : Fin 6 → ℝ) (i : Fin 4) :
    quadraticPhase c l e (unit i) = c * l i

name: Hellinger.BentFourStructure.sqrt_degree_mean
statement:
theorem sqrt_degree_mean :
    mean (fun x : Cube 4 => Real.sqrt (degree x)) =
      (3 + 3 * Real.sqrt 2 + 2 * Real.sqrt 3) / 8

name: Hellinger.BentFourFinal.bent_four_hellinger
statement:
theorem bent_four_hellinger (f : Cube 4 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    objective ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f) ≤ 1 - root ρ ∧
      (0 < ρ → objective ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - root ρ)

name: Hellinger.BentFourFinal.bent_four_low_strict
statement:
theorem bent_four_low_strict (f : Cube 4 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hlo : 5 / 6 ≤ ρ) :
    objective ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - root ρ

name: Hellinger.BentFourFinal.bent_four_middle_strict
statement:
theorem bent_four_middle_strict (f : Cube 4 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (ht₀ : 1 / 16 ≤ ρ ^ 2) (ht₁ : ρ ^ 2 ≤ 7 / 10) :
    objective ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f) < 1 - root ρ

name: Hellinger.BentFourFinal.bent_fourth_moment_identity
statement:
theorem bent_fourth_moment_identity (f : Cube 4 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 4) =
      (∑ s : Cube 4, noiseDerivativeSum (mixedTerms (dual f)) ρ s ^ 2) / 256

name: Hellinger.BentFourFinal.bent_fourth_moment_upper
statement:
theorem bent_fourth_moment_upper (f : Cube 4 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : Flatness.IsBent f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 4) ≤
      BentEstimates.bentH (ρ ^ 2) ^ 2 / 256

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.bent2_hellinger
statement:
theorem bent2_hellinger (f : (Fin 2 → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : IsBent2 f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    objective ((cubeBSC 2 ρ hρ).apply f) ≤ 1 - root ρ

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.bent2_hellinger_strict
statement:
theorem bent2_hellinger_strict (f : (Fin 2 → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : IsBent2 f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) :

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.canonical_hellinger
statement:
theorem canonical_hellinger (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    objective ((cubeBSC 2 ρ hρ).apply canonical) ≤ 1 - root ρ

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.canonical_hellinger_strict
statement:
theorem canonical_hellinger_strict (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hρpos : 0 < ρ) :
    objective ((cubeBSC 2 ρ hρ).apply canonical) < 1 - root ρ

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.canonical_mean
statement: theorem canonical_mean : mean canonical = (1 : ℝ) / 2

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.canonical_objective
statement:
theorem canonical_objective (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    objective ((cubeBSC 2 ρ hρ).apply canonical) = Real.sqrt 3 / 2 - twoNoiseR ρ

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.canonical_posterior_ff
statement:
theorem canonical_posterior_ff (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (cubeBSC 2 ρ hρ).apply canonical ![false, false] = (1 + 2 * ρ - ρ ^ 2) / 2

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.canonical_posterior_ft
statement:
theorem canonical_posterior_ft (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (cubeBSC 2 ρ hρ).apply canonical ![false, true] = (1 + ρ ^ 2) / 2

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.canonical_posterior_root_mean
statement:
theorem canonical_posterior_root_mean (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC 2 ρ hρ).apply canonical y)) = twoNoiseR ρ

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.canonical_posterior_tf
statement:
theorem canonical_posterior_tf (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (cubeBSC 2 ρ hρ).apply canonical ![true, false] = (1 + ρ ^ 2) / 2

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.canonical_posterior_tt
statement:
theorem canonical_posterior_tt (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (cubeBSC 2 ρ hρ).apply canonical ![true, true] = (1 - 2 * ρ - ρ ^ 2) / 2

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.canonical_root_mean
statement: theorem canonical_root_mean : root (mean canonical) = Real.sqrt 3 / 2

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.classify_bent2
statement:
theorem classify_bent2 (f : (Fin 2 → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hb : IsBent2 f) :
    ∃ p : Bool × Bool, ∃ complement : Bool, f = eightPhase p complement

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.classify_of_mean_sq
statement:
theorem classify_of_mean_sq (f : (Fin 2 → Bool) → ℝ)

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.eightPhase_boolean
statement:
theorem eightPhase_boolean (p : Bool × Bool) (complement : Bool) (x : Fin 2 → Bool) :
    eightPhase p complement x = -1 ∨ eightPhase p complement x = 1

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.eightPhase_hellinger
statement:
theorem eightPhase_hellinger (p : Bool × Bool) (complement : Bool)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.eightPhase_hellinger_strict

theorem eightPhase_hellinger_strict (p : Bool × Bool) (complement : Bool)

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.eightPhase_isBent2
statement: theorem eightPhase_isBent2 (p : Bool × Bool) (complement : Bool) : IsBent2 (eightPhase p complement)

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.eightPhase_objective
statement:
theorem eightPhase_objective (p : Bool × Bool) (complement : Bool)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    objective ((cubeBSC 2 ρ hρ).apply (eightPhase p complement)) =

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.normalizedWalsh_zero
statement:
theorem normalizedWalsh_zero (f : (Fin 2 → Bool) → ℝ) :
    normalizedWalsh f (false, false) = mean f

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.objective_apply_neg
statement:
theorem objective_apply_neg {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    objective (K.apply (fun x => -f x)) = objective (K.apply f)

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.pointPhase_mean
statement: theorem pointPhase_mean (p : Bool × Bool) : mean (pointPhase p) = (1 : ℝ) / 2

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.pointPhase_objective
statement:
theorem pointPhase_objective (p : Bool × Bool)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    objective ((cubeBSC 2 ρ hρ).apply (pointPhase p)) = Real.sqrt 3 / 2 - twoNoiseR ρ

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.pointPhase_posterior
statement:
theorem pointPhase_posterior (p : Bool × Bool) (y₀ y₁ : Bool)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (cubeBSC 2 ρ hρ).apply (pointPhase p) ![y₀, y₁] =
      if y₀ = p.1 then
        (if y₁ = p.2 then (1 - 2 * ρ - ρ ^ 2) / 2 else (1 + ρ ^ 2) / 2)
      else
        (if y₁ = p.2 then (1 + ρ ^ 2) / 2 else (1 + 2 * ρ - ρ ^ 2) / 2)

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.pointPhase_posterior_root_mean
statement:
theorem pointPhase_posterior_root_mean (p : Bool × Bool)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC 2 ρ hρ).apply (pointPhase p) y)) = twoNoiseR ρ

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.sum_two_bits
statement:
theorem sum_two_bits (f : (Fin 2 → Bool) → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, f x) = f ![false, false] + f ![false, true] +

name: Hellinger.TwoBitCase.two_bits_ext
statement:
theorem two_bits_ext {f g : (Fin 2 → Bool) → ℝ}

    (hft : f ![false, true] = g ![false, true])
    (htf : f ![true, false] = g ![true, false])
    (htt : f ![true, true] = g ![true, true]) : f = g
