name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.abs_blockDiagonal
statement:
theorem abs_blockDiagonal (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℝ) :
    CFC.abs (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (CFC.abs A) 0 0 (CFC.abs B)

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.abs_conjugate
statement:
theorem abs_conjugate (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℝ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    CFC.abs (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U A) = conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (CFC.abs A)

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.posSemidef_blockDiagonal
Hellinger.TraceNorm.posSemidef_conjugate
statement:
theorem posSemidef_conjugate (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℝ)
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U A).PosSemidef

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.scalarSign_bounds
statement: theorem scalarSign_bounds (x : ℝ) : -1 ≤ scalarSign x ∧ scalarSign x ≤ 1

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.scalarSign_mul
statement: theorem scalarSign_mul (x : ℝ) : scalarSign x * x = |x|

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.signWitness_attains
statement:
theorem signWitness_attains {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (signWitness hA * A).trace = traceNorm A

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.signWitness_orderContraction
statement:
theorem signWitness_orderContraction {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    OrderContraction (signWitness hA)

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.sqrt_blockDiagonal
statement:
theorem sqrt_blockDiagonal {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {B : Matrix κ κ ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    CFC.sqrt (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (CFC.sqrt A) 0 0 (CFC.sqrt B)

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_add_le
statement:
theorem traceNorm_add_le {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    traceNorm (A + B) ≤ traceNorm A + traceNorm B

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_blockDiagonal
statement:
theorem traceNorm_blockDiagonal (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℝ) :
    traceNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B) = traceNorm A + traceNorm B

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_conjugate
statement:
theorem traceNorm_conjugate (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℝ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    traceNorm (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U A) = traceNorm A

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_eq_sum_abs_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem traceNorm_eq_sum_abs_eigenvalues {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    traceNorm A = ∑ i, |hA.eigenvalues i|

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_eq_trace_sqrt
statement:
theorem traceNorm_eq_trace_sqrt (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    traceNorm A = (CFC.sqrt (A.transpose * A)).trace

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem traceNorm_eq_zero_iff (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : traceNorm A = 0 ↔ A = 0

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem traceNorm_neg (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : traceNorm (-A) = traceNorm A

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_nonneg
statement: theorem traceNorm_nonneg (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : 0 ≤ traceNorm A

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_of_posSemidef
statement:
theorem traceNorm_of_posSemidef (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    traceNorm A = A.trace

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_paired_difference
statement:
theorem traceNorm_paired_difference (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℝ)
    (A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    traceNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks (A - conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U B) 0 0
      (B - conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (star U) A)) =
      2 * traceNorm (A - conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U B)

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_smul
statement:
theorem traceNorm_smul (r : ℝ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    traceNorm (r • A) = |r| * traceNorm A

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_sum_le
statement:
theorem traceNorm_sum_le {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (A : α → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i ∈ s, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    traceNorm (∑ i ∈ s, A i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, traceNorm (A i)

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem traceNorm_zero : traceNorm (0 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) = 0

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.trace_blockDiagonal
statement:
theorem trace_blockDiagonal (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℝ) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B).trace = A.trace + B.trace

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.trace_cfc
statement:
theorem trace_cfc {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (cfc f A).trace = ∑ i, f (hA.eigenvalues i)

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.trace_conjugate
statement:
theorem trace_conjugate (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℝ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U A).trace = A.trace

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.trace_mul_le_traceNorm
Hellinger.TraceNorm.eigenvalue_mul_norm_sq_le_inner
statement:
theorem eigenvalue_mul_norm_sq_le_inner {T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E} (hT : T.IsSymmetric)
    (hd : Module.finrank ℝ E = d) (k : Fin d) (x : E)
    (hx : ∀ j : Fin d, k < j → (hT.eigenvectorBasis hd).repr x j = 0) :
    hT.eigenvalues hd k * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, T x⟫_ℝ

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.eigenvalues₀_conjugate
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_conjugate {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℝ) :
    (isHermitian_conjugate hA U).eigenvalues₀ = hA.eigenvalues₀

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.eigenvalues₀_diagonal_of_antitone
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_diagonal_of_antitone {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → ℝ) (ha : Antitone a) :
    (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal a).eigenvalues₀ =
      fun j => a (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin N) j)

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.exists_initial_final_vector
statement:
theorem exists_initial_final_vector (b c : OrthonormalBasis (Fin d) ℝ E) (k : Fin d) :
    ∃ x : E, x ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ j : Fin d, k < j → b.repr x j = 0) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin d, j < k → c.repr x j = 0)

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.initialCoordinates_injective
statement:
theorem initialCoordinates_injective {d k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ d) :
    Function.Injective (initialCoordinates d k)

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.inner_apply_eq_sum_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem inner_apply_eq_sum_eigenvalues {T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E} (hT : T.IsSymmetric)
    (hd : Module.finrank ℝ E = d) (x : E) :
    ⟪x, T x⟫_ℝ = ∑ j, hT.eigenvalues hd j * ((hT.eigenvectorBasis hd).repr x j) ^ 2

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.inner_le_eigenvalue_mul_norm_sq
statement:
theorem inner_le_eigenvalue_mul_norm_sq {T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E} (hT : T.IsSymmetric)
    (hd : Module.finrank ℝ E = d) (k : Fin d) (x : E)
    (hx : ∀ j : Fin d, j < k → (hT.eigenvectorBasis hd).repr x j = 0) :
    ⟪x, T x⟫_ℝ ≤ hT.eigenvalues hd k * ‖x‖ ^ 2

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.isHermitian_conjugate
statement:
theorem isHermitian_conjugate {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℝ) : (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U A).IsHermitian

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.matrix_eigenvalues_mono
Hellinger.TraceNorm.norm_sq_eq_sum_repr_sq
statement:
theorem norm_sq_eq_sum_repr_sq (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin d) ℝ E) (x : E) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ j, (b.repr x j) ^ 2

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.ordered_eigenvalue_distance_le_traceNorm
Hellinger.TraceNorm.ordered_eigenvalue_distance_le_traceNorm_conjugate
statement:
theorem ordered_eigenvalue_distance_le_traceNorm_conjugate {A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℝ) :
    (∑ j, |hA.eigenvalues₀ j - hB.eigenvalues₀ j|) ≤
      traceNorm (A - conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U B)

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.sorted_diagonal_distance_le_traceNorm
statement:
theorem sorted_diagonal_distance_le_traceNorm {N : ℕ} (a b : Fin N → ℝ)
    (ha : Antitone a) (hb : Antitone b) (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin N) ℝ) :
    (∑ j, |a j - b j|) ≤ traceNorm
      (Matrix.diagonal a - conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.diagonal b))

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.sum_positive_eigenvalue_differences_le
Hellinger.TraceNorm.symmetric_eigenvalues_mono
statement:
theorem symmetric_eigenvalues_mono {T S : E →ₗ[ℝ] E}
    (hT : T.IsSymmetric) (hS : S.IsSymmetric) (hd : Module.finrank ℝ E = d)
    (hTS : ∀ x : E, ⟪x, T x⟫_ℝ ≤ ⟪x, S x⟫_ℝ) (k : Fin d) :
    hT.eigenvalues hd k ≤ hS.eigenvalues hd k

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀
statement:
theorem trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues₀ {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    A.trace = ∑ j : Fin (Fintype.card ι), hA.eigenvalues₀ j

name: Hellinger.Fourier.card_degree
statement:
theorem card_degree (n k : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun s : Cube n => degree s = k)).card = n.choose k

name: Hellinger.Fourier.card_even_degree
statement:
theorem card_even_degree (n : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun s : Cube (n + 1) => Even (degree s))).card = 2 ^ n

name: Hellinger.Fourier.card_odd_degree
statement:
theorem card_odd_degree (n : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun s : Cube (n + 1) => Odd (degree s))).card = 2 ^ n

name: Hellinger.Fourier.degree_le
statement: theorem degree_le {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n) : degree s ≤ n

name: Hellinger.Fourier.parity_card_eq
statement:
theorem parity_card_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun s : Cube (n + 1) => Even (degree s))).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun s : Cube (n + 1) => Odd (degree s))).card

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.abs_submatrix_equiv
statement:
theorem abs_submatrix_equiv (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (e : κ ≃ ι) :
    CFC.abs (A.submatrix e e) = (CFC.abs A).submatrix e e

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.traceNorm_submatrix_equiv
statement:
theorem traceNorm_submatrix_equiv (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (e : κ ≃ ι) :
    traceNorm (A.submatrix e e) = traceNorm A

name: Hellinger.TraceNorm.trace_submatrix_equiv
statement:
theorem trace_submatrix_equiv (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (e : κ ≃ ι) :
    (A.submatrix e e).trace = A.trace

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.one_sub_inner_sq_nonneg
statement:
theorem one_sub_inner_sq_nonneg (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) (hw : w ⬝ᵥ w = 1) : 0 ≤ 1 - (v ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.outer_mul
statement:
theorem outer_mul (u v w z : ι → ℝ) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec u v * Matrix.vecMulVec w z = (v ⬝ᵥ w) • Matrix.vecMulVec u z

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.pureDifference_cube
statement:
theorem pureDifference_cube (v w : ι → ℝ) (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) (hw : w ⬝ᵥ w = 1) :
    pureDifference v w * pureDifference v w * pureDifference v w =
      (1 - (v ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2) • pureDifference v w

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.pureDifference_isHermitian
statement: theorem pureDifference_isHermitian (v w : ι → ℝ) : (pureDifference v w).IsHermitian

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.pureDifference_square
statement:
theorem pureDifference_square (v w : ι → ℝ) (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) (hw : w ⬝ᵥ w = 1) :
    pureDifference v w * pureDifference v w =
      Matrix.vecMulVec v v + Matrix.vecMulVec w w -
        (v ⬝ᵥ w) • Matrix.vecMulVec v w - (v ⬝ᵥ w) • Matrix.vecMulVec w v

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.pureDifference_square_posSemidef
statement:
theorem pureDifference_square_posSemidef (v w : ι → ℝ) :
    (pureDifference v w * pureDifference v w).PosSemidef

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.pureDifference_square_trace
statement:
theorem pureDifference_square_trace (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) (hw : w ⬝ᵥ w = 1) :
    (pureDifference v w * pureDifference v w).trace = 2 * (1 - (v ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.traceNorm_pureDifference
statement:
theorem traceNorm_pureDifference (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) (hw : w ⬝ᵥ w = 1) :
    traceNorm (pureDifference v w) = 2 * Real.sqrt (1 - (v ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.MatrixLifting.traceNorm_weighted_pureDifference_le
statement:
theorem traceNorm_weighted_pureDifference_le {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (p : α → ℝ) (v w : α → ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ y, 0 ≤ p y)
    (hv : ∀ y, v y ⬝ᵥ v y = 1) (hw : ∀ y, w y ⬝ᵥ w y = 1) :
    traceNorm (∑ y, p y • pureDifference (v y) (w y)) ≤
      ∑ y, p y * (2 * Real.sqrt (1 - (v y ⬝ᵥ w y) ^ 2))

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.abs_alternating_partial_choose
statement:
theorem abs_alternating_partial_choose (n k : ℕ) :
    |∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * ((n + 1).choose j : ℝ)| =
      (n.choose k : ℝ)

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.abs_level_sub_eq_sum_gaps
statement:
theorem abs_level_sub_eq_sum_gaps (level : ℕ → ℝ) (d s t : ℕ)
    (hlevel : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → j ≤ d → level j ≤ level i)
    (hs : s ≤ d) (ht : t ≤ d) :
    |level s - level t| =
      ∑ k ∈ range d, (level k - level (k + 1)) *
        |cutIndicator s k - cutIndicator t k|

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.alternating_partial_choose
statement:
theorem alternating_partial_choose (n k : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * ((n + 1).choose j : ℝ)) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * (n.choose k : ℝ)

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.cumulative_from_multiplicities
statement:
theorem cumulative_from_multiplicities {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (n k : ℕ) (p q : ι → ℕ)
    (hmult : ∀ j ≤ k,
      (∑ i, if p i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) -
        (∑ i, if q i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
          (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * (n.choose j : ℝ)) :
    (∑ i, cutIndicator (p i) k) - (∑ i, cutIndicator (q i) k) =
      ∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * (n.choose j : ℝ)

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.cutIndicator_antitone
statement:
theorem cutIndicator_antitone (s t k : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    cutIndicator t k ≤ cutIndicator s k

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.cutIndicator_eq_sum_multiplicities
statement:
theorem cutIndicator_eq_sum_multiplicities (s k : ℕ) :
    cutIndicator s k = ∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), (if s = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.evenMultiplicity_sub_oddMultiplicity
statement:
theorem evenMultiplicity_sub_oddMultiplicity (d k : ℕ) :
    evenMultiplicity d k - oddMultiplicity d k =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * (d.choose k : ℝ)

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.monotone_cuts_nested
statement:
theorem monotone_cuts_nested {ι : Type*} [LinearOrder ι]
    (p q : ι → ℕ) (hp : Monotone p) (hq : Monotone q) (k : ℕ) :
    (∀ i, cutIndicator (p i) k ≤ cutIndicator (q i) k) ∨
      (∀ i, cutIndicator (q i) k ≤ cutIndicator (p i) k)

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.ordered_layer_distance
statement:
theorem ordered_layer_distance {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (level : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ) (p q : ι → ℕ)
    (hp : Monotone p) (hq : Monotone q)
    (hp_bound : ∀ i, p i ≤ d) (hq_bound : ∀ i, q i ≤ d)
    (hlevel : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → j ≤ d → level j ≤ level i) :
    (∑ i, |level (p i) - level (q i)|) =
      ∑ k ∈ range d, (level k - level (k + 1)) *
        |(∑ i, cutIndicator (p i) k) - ∑ i, cutIndicator (q i) k|

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.parityLayerDistance_normalized
statement:
theorem parityLayerDistance_normalized (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    parityLayerDistance (n + 1) ((1 + c) / 2) ((1 - c) / 2) = c

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.parityLayerDistance_succ
statement:
theorem parityLayerDistance_succ (n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) :
    parityLayerDistance (n + 1) a b = (a - b) * (a + b) ^ n

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.parity_spectra_l1
statement:
theorem parity_spectra_l1 (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c) (hc₁ : c ≤ 1)
    (p q : Fin (2 ^ n) → ℕ) (hp : Monotone p) (hq : Monotone q)
    (hp_bound : ∀ i, p i ≤ n + 1) (hq_bound : ∀ i, q i ≤ n + 1)
    (heven : ∀ k ≤ n + 1,
      (∑ i, if p i = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = evenMultiplicity (n + 1) k)
    (hodd : ∀ k ≤ n + 1,
      (∑ i, if q i = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = oddMultiplicity (n + 1) k) :
    (∑ i, |spectralLevel (n + 1) (p i) ((1 + c) / 2) ((1 - c) / 2) -
      spectralLevel (n + 1) (q i) ((1 + c) / 2) ((1 - c) / 2)|) = c

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.sorted_parity_spectrum_distance
statement:
theorem sorted_parity_spectrum_distance {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c) (hc₁ : c ≤ 1)
    (p q : ι → ℕ) (hp : Monotone p) (hq : Monotone q)
    (hp_bound : ∀ i, p i ≤ n + 1) (hq_bound : ∀ i, q i ≤ n + 1)
    (hmult : ∀ k ≤ n + 1,
      (∑ i, if p i = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) -
        (∑ i, if q i = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
          (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * ((n + 1).choose k : ℝ)) :
    (∑ i, |spectralLevel (n + 1) (p i) ((1 + c) / 2) ((1 - c) / 2) -
      spectralLevel (n + 1) (q i) ((1 + c) / 2) ((1 - c) / 2)|) = c

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.spectralLevel_antitone
statement:
theorem spectralLevel_antitone (n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : b ≤ a)
    (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ n) :
    spectralLevel n j a b ≤ spectralLevel n i a b

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.spectralLevel_gap
statement:
theorem spectralLevel_gap (n k : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    spectralLevel (n + 1) k a b - spectralLevel (n + 1) (k + 1) a b =
      (a - b) * a ^ (n - k) * b ^ k

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.spectralLevel_step
statement:
theorem spectralLevel_step (n k : ℕ) (a b : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : b ≤ a) (hk : k < n) :
    spectralLevel n (k + 1) a b ≤ spectralLevel n k a b

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.sum_abs_cutIndicator_sub
statement:
theorem sum_abs_cutIndicator_sub {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (p q : ι → ℕ) (hp : Monotone p) (hq : Monotone q) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ i, |cutIndicator (p i) k - cutIndicator (q i) k|) =
      |(∑ i, cutIndicator (p i) k) - ∑ i, cutIndicator (q i) k|

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.sum_gaps_cutIndicator
statement:
theorem sum_gaps_cutIndicator (level : ℕ → ℝ) (d s : ℕ) (hs : s ≤ d) :
    (∑ k ∈ range d, (level k - level (k + 1)) * cutIndicator s k) =
      level s - level d

name: Hellinger.ParitySpectrum.weighted_layer_gaps
statement:
theorem weighted_layer_gaps (n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), (n.choose k : ℝ) *
      (spectralLevel (n + 1) k a b - spectralLevel (n + 1) (k + 1) a b)) =
      (a - b) * (a + b) ^ n

name: Hellinger.ProductState.antipodalMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem antipodalMatrix_apply (n : ℕ) (v : Cube n → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    (antipodalMatrix n *ᵥ v) x = v (antipode n x)

name: Hellinger.ProductState.antipodalMatrix_character
statement:
theorem antipodalMatrix_character (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : Cube n) :
    (antipodalMatrix n *ᵥ character n S) x = (-1 : ℝ) ^ S.card * character n S x

name: Hellinger.ProductState.antipodalMatrix_diagonalization
statement:
theorem antipodalMatrix_diagonalization (n : ℕ) :
    hadamard n * antipodalMatrix n * hadamard n =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun s => (-1 : ℝ) ^ Fourier.degree s)

name: Hellinger.ProductState.antipodalMatrix_mul_hadamard
statement:
theorem antipodalMatrix_mul_hadamard (n : ℕ) :
    antipodalMatrix n * hadamard n =
      hadamard n * Matrix.diagonal (fun s => (-1 : ℝ) ^ Fourier.degree s)

name: Hellinger.ProductState.antipodalMatrix_phase
statement:
theorem antipodalMatrix_phase (n : ℕ) (s : Cube n) (x : Cube n) :
    (antipodalMatrix n *ᵥ Fourier.phase s) x =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ Fourier.degree s * Fourier.phase s x

name: Hellinger.ProductState.character_antipode
statement:
theorem character_antipode (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : Cube n) :
    character n S (antipode n x) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ S.card * character n S x

name: Hellinger.ProductState.hadamardUnitary_coe
statement:
theorem hadamardUnitary_coe (n : ℕ) :
    (hadamardUnitary n : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ) = hadamard n

name: Hellinger.ProductState.hadamard_squared
statement: theorem hadamard_squared (n : ℕ) : hadamard n * hadamard n = 1

name: Hellinger.ProductState.hadamard_transpose
statement: theorem hadamard_transpose (n : ℕ) : (hadamard n).transpose = hadamard n

name: Hellinger.ProductState.normalization_square
statement: theorem normalization_square (n : ℕ) : normalization n ^ 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ n = 1

name: Hellinger.ProductState.oneQubit_apply_one
statement:
theorem oneQubit_apply_one (c : ℝ) (x : Bool) :
    (oneQubit c *ᵥ (fun _ => 1)) x = (1 + c) / 2

name: Hellinger.ProductState.oneQubit_apply_sign
statement:
theorem oneQubit_apply_sign (c : ℝ) (x : Bool) :
    (oneQubit c *ᵥ boolSign) x = (1 - c) / 2 * boolSign x

name: Hellinger.ProductState.oneQubit_symmetric
statement:
theorem oneQubit_symmetric (c : ℝ) (x z : Bool) :
    oneQubit c x z = oneQubit c z x

name: Hellinger.ProductState.product_two_levels
statement:
theorem product_two_levels (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (a b : ℝ) :
    (∏ i : Fin n, if i ∈ S then b else a) = a ^ (n - S.card) * b ^ S.card

name: Hellinger.ProductState.state_apply_product
statement:
theorem state_apply_product (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f : Fin n → Bool → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    (state n c *ᵥ (fun z => ∏ i, f i (z i))) x =
      ∏ i, (oneQubit c *ᵥ f i) (x i)

name: Hellinger.ProductState.state_character
statement:
theorem state_character (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (c : ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    (state n c *ᵥ character n S) x =
      ((1 + c) / 2) ^ (n - S.card) * ((1 - c) / 2) ^ S.card * character n S x

name: Hellinger.ProductState.state_diagonalization
statement:
theorem state_diagonalization (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    hadamard n * state n c * hadamard n = Matrix.diagonal (eigenvalue n c)

name: Hellinger.ProductState.state_entry
statement:
theorem state_entry (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (x z : Cube n) :
    state n c x z = c ^ hammingDistance n x z / (2 : ℝ) ^ n

name: Hellinger.ProductState.state_isHermitian
statement: theorem state_isHermitian (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : (state n c).IsHermitian

name: Hellinger.ProductState.state_mul_hadamard
statement:
theorem state_mul_hadamard (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    state n c * hadamard n = hadamard n * Matrix.diagonal (eigenvalue n c)

name: Hellinger.ProductState.state_phase
statement:
theorem state_phase (n : ℕ) (s : Cube n) (c : ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    (state n c *ᵥ Fourier.phase s) x =
      ((1 + c) / 2) ^ (n - Fourier.degree s) *
      ((1 - c) / 2) ^ Fourier.degree s * Fourier.phase s x

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.average_difference
statement:
theorem average_difference (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    averageProjection K - reflection f * averageProjection K * reflection f =
      ∑ y, (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ •
        pureDifference (posteriorVector K y) (reflectedVector f (posteriorVector K y))

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.bsc_lifting
statement:
theorem bsc_lifting (n : ℕ) (f : ProductState.Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    traceNorm (ProductState.state n (root ρ) -
      reflection f * ProductState.state n (root ρ) * reflection f) / 2 ≤
      mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y))

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.bsc_projection_sum
statement:
theorem bsc_projection_sum (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x z : Bool) :
    (∑ y : Bool, Real.sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).weight y x) *
      Real.sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).weight y z)) = if x = z then 1 else root ρ

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.bsc_sqrt_cross
statement:
theorem bsc_sqrt_cross (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Real.sqrt ((1 + ρ) / 2) * Real.sqrt ((1 - ρ) / 2) = root ρ / 2

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.cube_averageProjection
statement:
theorem cube_averageProjection (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    averageProjection (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) = ProductState.state n (root ρ)

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.cube_posterior_product
statement:
theorem cube_posterior_product (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (y x : ProductState.Cube n) :
    posteriorVector (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y x =
      ∏ i, Real.sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).weight (y i) (x i))

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.posteriorVector_unit
statement:
theorem posteriorVector_unit (K : UniformChannel Ω) (y : Ω) :
    posteriorVector K y ⬝ᵥ posteriorVector K y = 1

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.posterior_inner
statement:
theorem posterior_inner (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (y : Ω) :
    posteriorVector K y ⬝ᵥ reflectedVector f (posteriorVector K y) = K.apply f y

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.reflectedVector_unit
statement:
theorem reflectedVector_unit (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (y : Ω) :
    reflectedVector f (posteriorVector K y) ⬝ᵥ
      reflectedVector f (posteriorVector K y) = 1

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.reflected_projection
statement:
theorem reflected_projection (f v : Ω → ℝ) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec (reflectedVector f v) (reflectedVector f v) =
      reflection f * Matrix.vecMulVec v v * reflection f

name: Hellinger.PosteriorState.uniform_channel_lifting
statement:
theorem uniform_channel_lifting (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) :
    traceNorm (averageProjection K - reflection f * averageProjection K * reflection f) / 2 ≤
      mean (fun y => root (K.apply f y))

name: Hellinger.SortedEnumeration.card_filter_sortedEquiv
statement:
theorem card_filter_sortedEquiv (score : α → ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card α) => score (sortedEquiv score i) = k)).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : α => score x = k)).card

name: Hellinger.SortedEnumeration.mem_sortedList
statement: theorem mem_sortedList (score : α → ℕ) (x : α) : x ∈ sortedList score

name: Hellinger.SortedEnumeration.sortedEquiv_monotone
statement:
theorem sortedEquiv_monotone (score : α → ℕ) :
    Monotone (fun i => score (sortedEquiv score i))

name: Hellinger.SortedEnumeration.sortedList_length
statement: theorem sortedList_length (score : α → ℕ) : (sortedList score).length = Fintype.card α

name: Hellinger.SortedEnumeration.sortedList_nodup
statement: theorem sortedList_nodup (score : α → ℕ) : (sortedList score).Nodup

name: Hellinger.SortedEnumeration.sortedList_pairwise
statement:
theorem sortedList_pairwise (score : α → ℕ) :
    (sortedList score).Pairwise (fun a b => score a ≤ score b)

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.actual_block_trace
statement:
theorem actual_block_trace (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f : Fourier.Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode (n + 1) x) = -f x) :
    TraceNorm.traceNorm (state (n + 1) c -
      Matrix.diagonal f * state (n + 1) c * Matrix.diagonal f) =
      2 * TraceNorm.traceNorm (Matrix.diagonal (evenEigenvalue n c) -
        Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (blockUnitary n f hf hanti)
          (Matrix.diagonal (oddEigenvalue n c)))

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.actual_parity_spectra_l1
statement:
theorem actual_parity_spectra_l1 (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∑ i, |evenEigenvalue n c i - oddEigenvalue n c i|) = c

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.antipodal_hellinger
statement:
theorem antipodal_hellinger (n : ℕ) (f : Fourier.Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode (n + 1) x) = -f x)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    root ρ ≤ mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC (n + 1) ρ hρ).apply f y))

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.antipodal_trace_lower_bound
statement:
theorem antipodal_trace_lower_bound (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (f : Fourier.Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode (n + 1) x) = -f x) :
    c ≤ TraceNorm.traceNorm (state (n + 1) c -
      Matrix.diagonal f * state (n + 1) c * Matrix.diagonal f) / 2

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.blockEquiv_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockEquiv_inl (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) :
    blockEquiv n (Sum.inl i) = (evenEquiv n i).val

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.blockEquiv_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockEquiv_inr (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) :
    blockEquiv n (Sum.inr i) = (oddEquiv n i).val

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.difference_blocks
statement:
theorem difference_blocks (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f : Fourier.Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode (n + 1) x) = -f x) :
    (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary (n + 1))
      (state (n + 1) c - Matrix.diagonal f * state (n + 1) c * Matrix.diagonal f)).submatrix
        (blockEquiv n) (blockEquiv n) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks
        (Matrix.diagonal (evenEigenvalue n c) -
          offBlock n f * Matrix.diagonal (oddEigenvalue n c) * (offBlock n f).transpose) 0 0
        (Matrix.diagonal (oddEigenvalue n c) -
          (offBlock n f).transpose * Matrix.diagonal (evenEigenvalue n c) * offBlock n f)

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.evenEigenvalue_antitone
statement:
theorem evenEigenvalue_antitone (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Antitone (evenEigenvalue n c)

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.evenLevel_le
statement: theorem evenLevel_le (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) : evenLevel n i ≤ n + 1

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.evenLevel_monotone
statement: theorem evenLevel_monotone (n : ℕ) : Monotone (evenLevel n)

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.even_card
statement: theorem even_card (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (EvenIndex n) = 2 ^ n

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.even_multiplicities
statement:
theorem even_multiplicities (n k : ℕ) :
    (∑ i, if evenLevel n i = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      ParitySpectrum.evenMultiplicity (n + 1) k

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.oddEigenvalue_antitone
statement:
theorem oddEigenvalue_antitone (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Antitone (oddEigenvalue n c)

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.oddLevel_le
statement: theorem oddLevel_le (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) : oddLevel n i ≤ n + 1

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.oddLevel_monotone
statement: theorem oddLevel_monotone (n : ℕ) : Monotone (oddLevel n)

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.odd_card
statement: theorem odd_card (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (OddIndex n) = 2 ^ n

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.odd_multiplicities
statement:
theorem odd_multiplicities (n k : ℕ) :
    (∑ i, if oddLevel n i = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      ParitySpectrum.oddMultiplicity (n + 1) k

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.offBlock_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem offBlock_mul_transpose (n : ℕ) (f : Fourier.Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode (n + 1) x) = -f x) :
    offBlock n f * (offBlock n f).transpose = 1

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.parity_diagonal_blocks
statement:
theorem parity_diagonal_blocks (n : ℕ) :
    (parityDiagonal (n + 1)).submatrix (blockEquiv n) (blockEquiv n) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 0 (-1)

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.reflection_anticommutes
statement:
theorem reflection_anticommutes (n : ℕ) (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode n x) = -f x) :
    Matrix.diagonal f * antipodalMatrix n = -(antipodalMatrix n * Matrix.diagonal f)

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.reflection_blocks
statement:
theorem reflection_blocks (n : ℕ) (f : Fourier.Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode (n + 1) x) = -f x) :
    (transformedReflection (n + 1) f).submatrix (blockEquiv n) (blockEquiv n) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks 0 (offBlock n f) (offBlock n f).transpose 0

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.reflection_squared
statement:
theorem reflection_squared (n : ℕ) (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) : Matrix.diagonal f * Matrix.diagonal f = 1

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.state_diagonal_blocks
statement:
theorem state_diagonal_blocks (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (eigenvalue (n + 1) c)).submatrix (blockEquiv n) (blockEquiv n) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.diagonal (evenEigenvalue n c)) 0 0
        (Matrix.diagonal (oddEigenvalue n c))

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.subtype_degree_count
statement:
theorem subtype_degree_count (d k : ℕ) (p : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    (∑ s : {s : Fourier.Cube d // p (degree s)}, if degree s.val = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      if p k then (d.choose k : ℝ) else 0

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.transformedReflection_anticommutes
statement:
theorem transformedReflection_anticommutes (n : ℕ) (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode n x) = -f x) :
    transformedReflection n f * parityDiagonal n =
      -(parityDiagonal n * transformedReflection n f)

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.transformedReflection_isHermitian
statement:
theorem transformedReflection_isHermitian (n : ℕ) (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ) :
    (transformedReflection n f).IsHermitian

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.transformedReflection_same_parity_zero
statement:
theorem transformedReflection_same_parity_zero (n : ℕ) (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode n x) = -f x) (s t : Fourier.Cube n)
    (heq : (-1 : ℝ) ^ degree s = (-1 : ℝ) ^ degree t) :
    transformedReflection n f s t = 0

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.transformedReflection_squared
statement:
theorem transformedReflection_squared (n : ℕ) (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) :
    transformedReflection n f * transformedReflection n f = 1

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.transformed_antipodalMatrix
statement:
theorem transformed_antipodalMatrix (n : ℕ) :
    Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary n) (antipodalMatrix n) =
      parityDiagonal n

name: Hellinger.ParityBlocks.transformed_state
statement:
theorem transformed_state (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary n) (state n c) =
      Matrix.diagonal (eigenvalue n c)

name: Hellinger.ChannelSections.indexedBSC_apply_reindex
statement:
theorem indexedBSC_apply_reindex (e : ι ≃ κ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (f : (κ → Bool) → ℝ) (x : ι → Bool) :
    (indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).apply (f ∘ cubeEquiv e) x =
      (indexedBSC κ ρ hρ).apply f (cubeEquiv e x)

name: Hellinger.ChannelSections.indexedBSC_apply_split
statement:
theorem indexedBSC_apply_split (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (g : (({i // p i} → Bool) × ({i // ¬p i} → Bool)) → ℝ) (x : ι → Bool) :
    (indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).apply (g ∘ splitCube p) x =
      (productChannel (indexedBSC {i // p i} ρ hρ) (indexedBSC {i // ¬p i} ρ hρ)).apply
        g (splitCube p x)

name: Hellinger.ChannelSections.indexedBSC_root_sections
statement:
theorem indexedBSC_root_sections (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun z : {i // ¬p i} → Bool => mean (fun y : {i // p i} → Bool =>
      root ((indexedBSC {i // p i} ρ hρ).apply
        (fun w => f ((splitCube p).symm (w, z))) y))) ≤
      mean (fun y => root ((indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).apply f y))

name: Hellinger.ChannelSections.indexedBSC_weight_reindex
statement:
theorem indexedBSC_weight_reindex (e : ι ≃ κ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (x y : ι → Bool) :
    (indexedBSC κ ρ hρ).weight (cubeEquiv e x) (cubeEquiv e y) =
      (indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).weight x y

name: Hellinger.ChannelSections.indexedBSC_weight_split
statement:
theorem indexedBSC_weight_split (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x y : ι → Bool) :
    (productChannel (indexedBSC {i // p i} ρ hρ) (indexedBSC {i // ¬p i} ρ hρ)).weight
      (splitCube p x) (splitCube p y) = (indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).weight x y

name: Hellinger.ChannelSections.indexed_antipodal_hellinger
statement:
theorem indexed_antipodal_hellinger [Nonempty ι]
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (fun i => !(x i)) = -f x)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    root ρ ≤ mean (fun y => root ((indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).apply f y))

name: Hellinger.ChannelSections.mean_comp_equiv
statement: theorem mean_comp_equiv (e : Ω ≃ Λ) (f : Λ → ℝ) : mean (f ∘ e) = mean f

name: Hellinger.ChannelSections.mean_mono
statement: theorem mean_mono (f g : Ω → ℝ) (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) : mean f ≤ mean g

name: Hellinger.ChannelSections.mean_prod
statement:
theorem mean_prod (f : Ω × Λ → ℝ) :
    mean f = mean (fun x => mean (fun y => f (x, y)))

name: Hellinger.ChannelSections.mean_prod_swap
statement:
theorem mean_prod_swap (f : Ω × Λ → ℝ) :
    mean f = mean (fun y => mean (fun x => f (x, y)))

name: Hellinger.ChannelSections.productChannel_apply
statement:
theorem productChannel_apply (K : UniformChannel Ω) (L : UniformChannel Λ)
    (f : Ω × Λ → ℝ) (x : Ω) (y : Λ) :
    (productChannel K L).apply f (x, y) =
      L.apply (fun z => K.apply (fun w => f (w, z)) x) y

name: Hellinger.ChannelSections.sections_root_mean_le
statement:
theorem sections_root_mean_le (K : UniformChannel Ω) (L : UniformChannel Λ)
    (f : Ω × Λ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ p, f p ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun z => mean (fun y => root (K.apply (fun x => f (x, z)) y))) ≤
      mean (fun p => root ((productChannel K L).apply f p))

name: Hellinger.ChannelSections.split_flip_section
statement:
theorem split_flip_section (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (w : {i // i ∈ S} → Bool) (z : {i // i ∉ S} → Bool) :
    (splitCube (fun i => i ∈ S)).symm ((fun i => !(w i)), z) =
      PaperSpecs.flip S ((splitCube (fun i => i ∈ S)).symm (w, z))

name: Hellinger.ChannelSections.translation_hellinger
statement: theorem translation_hellinger : PaperSpecs.TranslationHellinger

name: Hellinger.convolution_objective_le
statement:
theorem convolution_objective_le (p f : G → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ e, 0 ≤ p e) (hs : ∑ e, p e = 1)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    objective (convolution p f) ≤ objective f

name: Hellinger.convolution_preserves_mean
statement:
theorem convolution_preserves_mean (p f : G → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ e, 0 ≤ p e) (hs : ∑ e, p e = 1) :
    mean (convolution p f) = mean f

name: Hellinger.translationChannel_apply
statement:
theorem translationChannel_apply (p f : G → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ e, 0 ≤ p e) (hs : ∑ e, p e = 1) (x : G) :
    (translationChannel p hp hs).apply f x = convolution p f x

name: Hellinger.F2Model.add_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem add_eq_zero_iff (x y : F2) : x + y = 0 ↔ x = y

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bitEquiv_false
statement: @[simp] theorem bitEquiv_false : bitEquiv false = 0

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bitEquiv_true
statement: @[simp] theorem bitEquiv_true : bitEquiv true = 1

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bitsEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem bitsEquiv_apply {ι : Type*} (x : ι → Bool) (i : ι) :
    bitsEquiv ι x i = bitEquiv (x i)

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bitsEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem bitsEquiv_symm_apply {ι : Type*} (x : ι → F2) (i : ι) :
    (bitsEquiv ι).symm x i = bitEquiv.symm (x i)

name: Hellinger.F2Model.errorMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem errorMass_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (e : ι → F2) : 0 ≤ errorMass ρ e

name: Hellinger.F2Model.errorMass_sum
statement:
theorem errorMass_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : (∑ e : ι → F2, errorMass ρ e) = 1

name: Hellinger.F2Model.noise_apply_additive
statement:
theorem noise_apply_additive {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (f : (ι → F2) → ℝ) (y : ι → F2) :
    (noise ι ρ hρ).apply f y = ∑ e, errorMass ρ e * f (y + e)

name: Hellinger.F2Model.noise_apply_bits
statement:
theorem noise_apply_bits {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (f : (ι → F2) → ℝ) (x : ι → Bool) :
    (noise ι ρ hρ).apply f (bitsEquiv ι x) =
      (ChannelSections.indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).apply (f ∘ bitsEquiv ι) x

name: Hellinger.F2Model.noise_weight_additive
statement:
theorem noise_weight_additive {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x y : ι → F2) :
    (noise ι ρ hρ).weight x y = errorMass ρ (x + y)

name: Hellinger.F2Model.noise_weight_bits
statement:
theorem noise_weight_bits {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x y : ι → Bool) :
    (noise ι ρ hρ).weight (bitsEquiv ι x) (bitsEquiv ι y) =
      (ChannelSections.indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).weight x y

name: Hellinger.F2Model.oneStep_weight
statement:
theorem oneStep_weight (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x y : F2) :
    (oneStep ρ hρ).weight x y = if x = y then (1 + ρ) / 2 else (1 - ρ) / 2

name: Hellinger.F2Model.sign_add
statement: theorem sign_add (a b : F2) : sign (a + b) = sign a * sign b

name: Hellinger.F2Model.sign_bit
statement: @[simp] theorem sign_bit (b : Bool) : sign (bitEquiv b) = boolSign b

name: Hellinger.F2Model.transportedChannel_apply
statement:
theorem transportedChannel_apply {Ω Λ : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Λ]
    (e : Ω ≃ Λ) (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Λ → ℝ) (x : Ω) :
    (transportedChannel e K).apply f (e x) = K.apply (f ∘ e) x

name: Hellinger.ColumnSelection.exists_column_basis
statement:
theorem exists_column_basis (n k : ℕ) (L : Cube n →ₗ[F2] Cube k)
    (hL : Function.Surjective L) :
    ∃ (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (b : Module.Basis (Fin k) F2 (Cube k)),
      ∀ i, b i = L (Pi.single (a i) 1)

name: Hellinger.ColumnSelection.span_columns_eq_top
statement:
theorem span_columns_eq_top (n k : ℕ) (L : Cube n →ₗ[F2] Cube k)
    (hL : Function.Surjective L) :
    Submodule.span F2 (Set.range (fun i : Fin n => L (Pi.single i 1))) = ⊤

name: Hellinger.ShearNoise.extraNoise_convex_mean_le
statement:
theorem extraNoise_convex_mean_le (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (D : (κ → F2) →ₗ[F2] (ι → F2)) (g : (ι → F2) → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ x, g x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (Ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (hΨ : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) Ψ) :
    mean (fun v => Ψ (extraNoise ρ D g v)) ≤ mean (fun v => Ψ (g v))

name: Hellinger.ShearNoise.extraNoise_mean
statement:
theorem extraNoise_mean (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (D : (κ → F2) →ₗ[F2] (ι → F2)) (g : (ι → F2) → ℝ) :
    mean (extraNoise ρ D g) = mean g

name: Hellinger.ShearNoise.mean_add
statement:
theorem mean_add (f : (ι → F2) → ℝ) (z : ι → F2) :
    mean (fun x => f (x + z)) = mean f

name: Hellinger.ShearNoise.mean_shear
statement:
theorem mean_shear (g : (ι → F2) → ℝ) (D : (κ → F2) →ₗ[F2] (ι → F2)) :
    mean (shearFunction g D) = mean g

name: Hellinger.ShearNoise.noise_apply_shift
statement:
theorem noise_apply_shift (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (f : (ι → F2) → ℝ) (y z : ι → F2) :
    (noise ι ρ hρ).apply (fun x => f (x + z)) y =
      (noise ι ρ hρ).apply f (y + z)

name: Hellinger.ShearNoise.product_shear_posterior
statement:
theorem product_shear_posterior (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (g : (ι → F2) → ℝ) (D : (κ → F2) →ₗ[F2] (ι → F2))
    (y : ι → F2) (z : κ → F2) :
    (productChannel (noise ι ρ hρ) (noise κ ρ hρ)).apply (shearFunction g D) (y, z) =
      extraNoise ρ D ((noise ι ρ hρ).apply g) (y + D z)

name: Hellinger.ShearNoise.shear_convex_comparison
statement:
theorem shear_convex_comparison (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (g : (ι → F2) → ℝ) (hg : ∀ x, g x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (D : (κ → F2) →ₗ[F2] (ι → F2))
    (Ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (hΨ : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) Ψ) :
    mean (fun y => Ψ ((productChannel (noise ι ρ hρ) (noise κ ρ hρ)).apply
      (shearFunction g D) y)) ≤ mean (fun y => Ψ ((noise ι ρ hρ).apply g y))

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.coordinatesLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinatesLinear_apply (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (x : Cube n) :
    coordinatesLinear a x = coordinates a x

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.coordinates_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinates_fst (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (x : Cube n) (i : Fin k) :
    (coordinates a x).1 i = x (a i)

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.coordinates_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinates_snd (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (x : Cube n) (i : Remaining a) :
    (coordinates a x).2 i = x i.val

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.indexEquiv_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem indexEquiv_inl (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (i : Fin k) :
    indexEquiv a (Sum.inl i) = a i

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.indexEquiv_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem indexEquiv_inr (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (i : Remaining a) :
    indexEquiv a (Sum.inr i) = i.val

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.noise_apply_coordinates
statement:
theorem noise_apply_coordinates (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (g : (Cube k × (Remaining a → F2)) → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    (noise (Fin n) ρ hρ).apply (g ∘ coordinates a) x =
      (productChannel (noise (Fin k) ρ hρ) (noise (Remaining a) ρ hρ)).apply g (coordinates a x)

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.noise_weight_coordinates
statement:
theorem noise_weight_coordinates (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x y : Cube n) :
    (productChannel (noise (Fin k) ρ hρ) (noise (Remaining a) ρ hρ)).weight
      (coordinates a x) (coordinates a y) = (noise (Fin n) ρ hρ).weight x y

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.quotient_assembly
statement:
theorem quotient_assembly (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (b : Module.Basis (Fin k) F2 (Cube k))
    (L : Cube n →ₗ[F2] Cube k) (hb : ∀ i, b i = L (Pi.single (a i) 1)) (x : Cube k) :
    L ((coordinatesLinear a).symm (x, 0)) = b.equivFun.symm x

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.quotient_coordinate_formula
statement:
theorem quotient_coordinate_formula (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (b : Module.Basis (Fin k) F2 (Cube k))
    (L : Cube n →ₗ[F2] Cube k) (hb : ∀ i, b i = L (Pi.single (a i) 1))
    (x : Cube k) (z : Remaining a → F2) :
    L ((coordinates a).symm (x, z)) = b.equivFun.symm (x + quotientShear a b L z)

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.selected_assembly
statement:
theorem selected_assembly (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (x : Cube k) :
    (coordinatesLinear a).symm (x, 0) = ∑ i, x i • Pi.single (a i) 1

name: Hellinger.PivotCoordinates.selected_single
statement:
theorem selected_single (a : Fin k ↪ Fin n) (i : Fin k) :
    coordinatesLinear a (Pi.single (a i) 1) = (Pi.single i 1, 0)

name: Hellinger.LinearQuotient.linear_quotient_boolean
statement:
theorem linear_quotient_boolean (n k : ℕ) (L : Cube n →ₗ[F2] Cube k)
    (hL : Function.Surjective L) (g : Cube k → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ x, g x = -1 ∨ g x = 1) :
    ∃ g₀ : Cube k → ℝ, (∀ x, g₀ x = -1 ∨ g₀ x = 1) ∧
      mean g₀ = mean (g ∘ L) ∧
      ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
        (Ψ : ℝ → ℝ), ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) Ψ →
        mean (fun y => Ψ ((noise (Fin n) ρ hρ).apply (g ∘ L) y)) ≤
          mean (fun y => Ψ ((noise (Fin k) ρ hρ).apply g₀ y))

name: Hellinger.LinearQuotient.linear_quotient_comparison
statement:
theorem linear_quotient_comparison (n k : ℕ) (L : Cube n →ₗ[F2] Cube k)
    (hL : Function.Surjective L) (g : Cube k → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ x, g x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ M : Cube k ≃ₗ[F2] Cube k,
      mean (g ∘ M) = mean (g ∘ L) ∧
      ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
        (Ψ : ℝ → ℝ), ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) Ψ →
        mean (fun y => Ψ ((noise (Fin n) ρ hρ).apply (g ∘ L) y)) ≤
          mean (fun y => Ψ ((noise (Fin k) ρ hρ).apply (g ∘ M) y))

name: Hellinger.LinearQuotient.linear_quotient_objective_comparison
statement:
theorem linear_quotient_objective_comparison (n k : ℕ) (L : Cube n →ₗ[F2] Cube k)
    (hL : Function.Surjective L) (g : Cube k → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ x, g x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ M : Cube k ≃ₗ[F2] Cube k,
      mean (g ∘ M) = mean (g ∘ L) ∧
      ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1),
        objective ((noise (Fin n) ρ hρ).apply (g ∘ L)) ≤
          objective ((noise (Fin k) ρ hρ).apply (g ∘ M))

name: Hellinger.F2Model.autocorrelation_bits
statement:
theorem autocorrelation_bits (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ) (v : Fourier.Cube n) :
    Fourier.autocorrelation (f ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) v =
      mean (fun x : Cube n => f x * f (x + bitsEquiv (Fin n) v))

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bent_autocorrelation
statement:
theorem bent_autocorrelation (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : Flatness.IsBent (f ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))) (v : Cube n) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    mean (fun x => f x * f (x + v)) = 0

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bent_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem bent_linearEquiv (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hb : Flatness.IsBent (f ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))) (M : Cube n ≃ₗ[F2] Cube n) :
    Flatness.IsBent ((f ∘ M) ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bent_of_autocorrelation
statement:
theorem bent_of_autocorrelation (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hc : ∀ v : Cube n, v ≠ 0 → mean (fun x => f x * f (x + v)) = 0) :
    Flatness.IsBent (f ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bitEquiv_xor
statement:
@[simp] theorem bitEquiv_xor (x y : Bool) :
    bitEquiv (Bool.xor x y) = bitEquiv x + bitEquiv y

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bitsEquiv_translate
statement:
theorem bitsEquiv_translate (n : ℕ) (x v : Fourier.Cube n) :
    bitsEquiv (Fin n) (Fourier.translate x v) = bitsEquiv (Fin n) x + bitsEquiv (Fin n) v

name: Hellinger.F2Model.bitsEquiv_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem bitsEquiv_zero (n : ℕ) : bitsEquiv (Fin n) (fun _ => false) = 0

name: Hellinger.F2Model.noise_objective_bits
statement:
theorem noise_objective_bits {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (f : (ι → F2) → ℝ) :
    objective ((noise ι ρ hρ).apply f) =
      objective ((indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).apply (f ∘ bitsEquiv ι))

name: Hellinger.F2Model.objective_comp_equiv
statement:
theorem objective_comp_equiv {Ω Λ : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Λ]
    (e : Ω ≃ Λ) (f : Λ → ℝ) : objective (f ∘ e) = objective f

name: Hellinger.F2Model.walsh_autocorrelation
statement:
theorem walsh_autocorrelation {n : ℕ} (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ) (t : Fourier.Cube n) :
    Fourier.walsh (Fourier.autocorrelation f) t = Fourier.walsh f t ^ 2

name: Hellinger.QuadraticRadical.character_mean_zero
statement:
theorem character_mean_zero {n : ℕ} (L : Cube n →ₗ[F2] F2)
    (hL : L ≠ 0) : mean (fun x => sign (L x)) = 0

name: Hellinger.QuadraticRadical.eq_one_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem eq_one_of_ne_zero (z : F2) (hz : z ≠ 0) : z = 1

name: Hellinger.QuadraticRadical.phase_bent
statement:
theorem phase_bent {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : Q.polarBilin.ker = ⊥) :
    Flatness.IsBent (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))

name: Hellinger.QuadraticRadical.phase_boolean
statement:
theorem phase_boolean {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n) (x : Cube n) :
    phase a Q x = -1 ∨ phase a Q x = 1

name: Hellinger.QuadraticRadical.phase_derivative
statement:
theorem phase_derivative {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n) (x v : Cube n) :
    phase a Q x * phase a Q (x + v) = sign (Q v) * sign (Q.polarBilin x v)

name: Hellinger.QuadraticRadical.polynomial_apply
statement:
theorem polynomial_apply {n : ℕ} (b : Fin n → F2) (q : Fin n → Fin n → F2)
    (x : Cube n) : polynomial b q x =
      (∑ i, b i * x i) + ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j => i < j),
        q i j * x i * x j

name: Hellinger.QuadraticRadical.polynomial_phase_bits
statement:
theorem polynomial_phase_bits {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (b : Fin n → F2)
    (q : Fin n → Fin n → F2) (x : PaperSpecs.Cube n) :
    phase a (polynomial b q) (bitsEquiv (Fin n) x) =
      if PaperSpecs.quadraticValue a b q x = 0 then 1 else -1

name: Hellinger.QuadraticRadical.radical_dichotomy
statement:
theorem radical_dichotomy {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n) :
    (∃ v : Cube n, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ x, phase a Q (x + v) = -phase a Q x) ∨
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (L : Cube n →ₗ[F2] Cube k), Function.Surjective L ∧
      ∃ Q₀ : Form k, Q₀.polarBilin.ker = ⊥ ∧ phase a Q = phase a Q₀ ∘ L

name: Hellinger.QuadraticRadical.sign_boolean
statement: theorem sign_boolean (z : F2) : sign z = -1 ∨ sign z = 1

name: Hellinger.QuadraticRadical.sign_one
statement: @[simp] theorem sign_one : sign (1 : F2) = -1

name: Hellinger.QuadraticRadical.sign_sq
statement: theorem sign_sq (z : F2) : sign z ^ 2 = 1

name: Hellinger.QuadraticRadical.sign_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem sign_zero : sign (0 : F2) = 1

name: Hellinger.Fourier.degree_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem degree_eq_one_iff {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n) :
    degree s = 1 ↔ ∃ i : Fin n, s = unit i

name: Hellinger.Fourier.degree_pos_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem degree_pos_of_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n) (hs : s ≠ (fun _ => false)) :
    0 < degree s

name: Hellinger.Fourier.degree_unit
statement: theorem degree_unit {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : degree (unit i) = 1

name: Hellinger.Fourier.degree_zero
statement: theorem degree_zero : ∀ n, degree (fun _ : Fin n => false) = 0

name: Hellinger.Fourier.high_walsh_eq_zero_of_noise_equality
statement:
theorem high_walsh_eq_zero_of_noise_equality {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hm : mean f = 0)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (heq : mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 2) = ρ ^ 2)
    (s : Cube n) (hs : 1 < degree s) : walsh f s = 0

name: Hellinger.Fourier.linear_expansion_of_high_walsh_zero
statement:
theorem linear_expansion_of_high_walsh_zero {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hm : mean f = 0) (hh : ∀ s, 1 < degree s → walsh f s = 0) (x : Cube n) :
    f x = ∑ i : Fin n, walsh f (unit i) * boolSign (x i)

name: Hellinger.Fourier.phase_unit
statement:
theorem phase_unit {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (x : Cube n) :
    phase (unit i) x = boolSign (x i)

name: Hellinger.Fourier.signed_dictator_of_noise_equality
statement:
theorem signed_dictator_of_noise_equality {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hm : mean f = 0)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (heq : mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 2) = ρ ^ 2) :
    ∃ i : Fin n, ∃ a : ℝ, (a = 1 ∨ a = -1) ∧
      ∀ x, f x = a * boolSign (x i)

name: Hellinger.Fourier.support_unit
statement: theorem support_unit {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : support (unit i) = {i}

name: Hellinger.Fourier.unit_injective
statement: theorem unit_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (unit (n := n))

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.anticommuting_trace_identity
Hellinger.TraceEquality.anticommuting_trace_le
statement:
theorem anticommuting_trace_le {K F Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hK : K.IsHermitian) (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hQ : OrderContraction Q)
    (ha : F * Q * F = -Q) :
    (K * Q).trace ≤ traceNorm (K - F * K * F) / 2

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.anticommuting_trace_maximum
statement:
theorem anticommuting_trace_maximum {K F : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hK : K.IsHermitian) (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hFsq : F * F = 1) :
    IsGreatest {t : ℝ | ∃ Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ, Q.IsHermitian ∧
      ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := ι) Q‖ ≤ 1 ∧ F * Q * F = -Q ∧
      t = (K * Q).trace} (traceNorm (K - F * K * F) / 2)

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.anticommuting_uncertainty
statement:
theorem anticommuting_uncertainty {F Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hFsq : F * F = 1) (hQ : OrderContraction Q)
    (ha : F * Q * F = -Q) (ψ : ι → ℝ) (hψ : ψ ⬝ᵥ ψ = 1) :
    (ψ ⬝ᵥ F *ᵥ ψ) ^ 2 + (ψ ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ ψ) ^ 2 ≤ 1

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.anticommuting_uncertainty_operatorNorm
statement:
theorem anticommuting_uncertainty_operatorNorm {F Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hFsq : F * F = 1) (hQ : Q.IsHermitian)
    (hn : ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := ι) Q‖ ≤ 1)
    (ha : F * Q * F = -Q) (ψ : ι → ℝ) (hψ : ψ ⬝ᵥ ψ = 1) :
    (ψ ⬝ᵥ F *ᵥ ψ) ^ 2 + (ψ ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ ψ) ^ 2 ≤ 1

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.common_pair_equality_gram
statement:
theorem common_pair_equality_gram {α : Type*} {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hQ : OrderContraction Q) (u v : α → ι → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ y, 0 < u y ⬝ᵥ u y) (hv : ∀ y, 0 < v y ⬝ᵥ v y)
    (heq : ∀ y, u y ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ v y = vectorNorm (u y) * vectorNorm (v y)) (y z : α) :
    (u y ⬝ᵥ u z) / (vectorNorm (u y) * vectorNorm (u z)) =
      (v y ⬝ᵥ v z) / (vectorNorm (v y) * vectorNorm (v z))

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.cross_isHermitian
statement:
theorem cross_isHermitian (u v : ι → ℝ) :
    (vecMulVec u v + vecMulVec v u).IsHermitian

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.dot_le_vectorNorm_mul
statement: theorem dot_le_vectorNorm_mul (u v : ι → ℝ) : u ⬝ᵥ v ≤ vectorNorm u * vectorNorm v

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.dot_mulVec_comm
statement:
theorem dot_mulVec_comm {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : Q.IsHermitian) (u v : ι → ℝ) :
    u ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ v = v ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ u

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.dot_self_nonneg
statement: theorem dot_self_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ v ⬝ᵥ v

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.exists_anticommuting_trace_witness
statement:
theorem exists_anticommuting_trace_witness {K F : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hK : K.IsHermitian) (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hFsq : F * F = 1) :
    ∃ Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ, Q.IsHermitian ∧ OrderContraction Q ∧ F * Q * F = -Q ∧
      (K * Q).trace = traceNorm (K - F * K * F) / 2

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.normalizedVector_dot
statement:
theorem normalizedVector_dot (u v : ι → ℝ) :

      (u ⬝ᵥ v) / (vectorNorm u * vectorNorm v)

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.normalizedVector_self
statement:
theorem normalizedVector_self {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : 0 < v ⬝ᵥ v) :

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.pair_equality_maps_normalized
statement:
theorem pair_equality_maps_normalized {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : OrderContraction Q)
    (u v : ι → ℝ) (hu : 0 < u ⬝ᵥ u) (hv : 0 < v ⬝ᵥ v)
    (heq : u ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ v = vectorNorm u * vectorNorm v) :
    Q *ᵥ normalizedVector v = normalizedVector u ∧

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.reflection_anticommutes
statement:
theorem reflection_anticommutes {F Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ}

theorem reflection_conjugate_isHermitian {F A : Matrix ι ι ℝ}

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.trace_mul_cross
statement:
theorem trace_mul_cross {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : Q.IsHermitian) (u v : ι → ℝ) :
    (Q * (vecMulVec u v + vecMulVec v u)).trace = 2 * (u ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ v)

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.trace_reflection_move
statement:
theorem trace_reflection_move (F A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    (F * A * F * B).trace = (A * (F * B * F)).trace

theorem unit_pair_equality_maps {Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hQ : OrderContraction Q)
