name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.vectorNorm_eq_norm
statement: theorem vectorNorm_eq_norm (v : ι → ℝ) : vectorNorm v = ‖toLp 2 v‖

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.vectorNorm_nonneg
statement: theorem vectorNorm_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ vectorNorm v

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.vectorNorm_pos
statement: theorem vectorNorm_pos {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : 0 < v ⬝ᵥ v) : 0 < vectorNorm v

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.vectorNorm_sq
statement: theorem vectorNorm_sq (v : ι → ℝ) : vectorNorm v ^ 2 = v ⬝ᵥ v

name: Hellinger.TraceEquality.weighted_cross_trace_equality_gram
statement:
theorem weighted_cross_trace_equality_gram {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (p : α → ℝ) (u v : α → ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ y, 0 < p y)
    (hu : ∀ y, 0 < u y ⬝ᵥ u y) (hv : ∀ y, 0 < v y ⬝ᵥ v y)
    (heq : traceNorm (∑ y, p y • (vecMulVec (u y) (v y) + vecMulVec (v y) (u y))) =
      2 * ∑ y, p y * vectorNorm (u y) * vectorNorm (v y)) (y z : α) :
    (u y ⬝ᵥ u z) / (vectorNorm (u y) * vectorNorm (u z)) =
      (v y ⬝ᵥ v z) / (vectorNorm (v y) * vectorNorm (v z))

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.apply_strict_bounds
statement:
theorem apply_strict_bounds {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (K : UniformChannel Ω) (hK : ∀ y x, 0 < K.weight y x) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z) (y : Ω) :
    -1 < K.apply f y ∧ K.apply f y < 1

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.average_component_cross
statement:
theorem average_component_cross {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (K : UniformChannel Ω) :
    averageProjection K - reflection f * averageProjection K * reflection f =
      (2 : ℝ) • ∑ y, (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ •
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (plusVector f K y) (minusVector f K y) +
          Matrix.vecMulVec (minusVector f K y) (plusVector f K y))

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.balanced_boolean_nonconstant
statement:
theorem balanced_boolean_nonconstant {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hm : mean f = 0) :
    ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.boolean_has_both_signs
statement:
theorem boolean_has_both_signs {Ω : Type*} (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z) :
    (∃ x, f x = 1) ∧ ∃ x, f x = -1

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.bsc_flip_sqrt_product
statement:
theorem bsc_flip_sqrt_product (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (y x : Bool) :
    Real.sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).weight y x) *
      Real.sqrt ((bsc ρ hρ).weight (!y) x) = root ρ / 2

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.bsc_flip_sum
statement:
theorem bsc_flip_sum (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (y x : Bool) :
    (bsc ρ hρ).weight y x + (bsc ρ hρ).weight (!y) x = 1

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.bsc_posterior_abs_constant_of_lifting_equality
statement:
theorem bsc_posterior_abs_constant_of_lifting_equality {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (heq : TraceNorm.traceNorm
      (ProductState.state n (root ρ) -
        reflection f * ProductState.state n (root ρ) * reflection f) / 2 =
        mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y))) :
    ∀ y z, |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y| = |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f z|

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.bsc_weight_pos
statement:
theorem bsc_weight_pos (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (y x : Bool) : 0 < (bsc ρ hρ).weight y x

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.component_norms_pos
statement:
theorem component_norms_pos {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρlt : ρ < 1) (y : Cube n) :
    0 < plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ∧
      0 < minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.component_orthogonal
statement:
theorem component_orthogonal {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (K : UniformChannel Ω) (y z : Ω) :
    plusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f K z = 0

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.cross_equality_of_lifting_equality
statement:
theorem cross_equality_of_lifting_equality {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (K : UniformChannel Ω)
    (heq : TraceNorm.traceNorm
      (averageProjection K - reflection f * averageProjection K * reflection f) / 2 =
        mean (fun y => root (K.apply f y))) :
    TraceNorm.traceNorm
      (∑ y, (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ •
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (plusVector f K y) (minusVector f K y) +
          Matrix.vecMulVec (minusVector f K y) (plusVector f K y))) =
      2 * ∑ y, (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        Real.sqrt (plusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ plusVector f K y) *
        Real.sqrt (minusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f K y)

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.cube_weight_neighbor_sum
statement:
theorem cube_weight_neighbor_sum {n : ℕ} (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (y x : Cube n) (i : Fin n) :
    (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight y x +
      (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight (Function.update y i (!(y i))) x =
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (bsc ρ hρ).weight (y j) (x j)

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.cube_weight_pos
statement:
theorem cube_weight_pos (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hρlt : ρ < 1) (y x : Cube n) : 0 < (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight y x

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.cube_weight_split
statement:
theorem cube_weight_split {n : ℕ} (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (y x : Cube n) (i : Fin n) :
    (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight y x =
      (bsc ρ hρ).weight (y i) (x i) *
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (bsc ρ hρ).weight (y j) (x j)

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.minus_neighbor_inner
statement:
theorem minus_neighbor_inner {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (y : Cube n) (i : Fin n) :
    minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ
      minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i))) =
      root ρ / 2 * (1 - ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y +
        (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f (Function.update y i (!(y i)))) / 2)

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.minus_norm_sq
statement:
theorem minus_norm_sq {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (K : UniformChannel Ω) (y : Ω) :
    minusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f K y = (1 - K.apply f y) / 2

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.noise_second_moment_of_abs_constant_and_objective_eq
statement:
theorem noise_second_moment_of_abs_constant_and_objective_eq {n : ℕ}
    (f : Cube n → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hm : mean f = 0)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (habs : ∀ y z, |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y| = |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f z|)
    (hobj : objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) = 1 - root ρ) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 2) = ρ ^ 2

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.normalized_gram_of_component_equality
statement:
theorem normalized_gram_of_component_equality (p q c : ℝ)
    (hp : -1 < p ∧ p < 1) (hq : -1 < q ∧ q < 1) (hc : 0 < c)
    (h :
      (c / 2 * (1 + (p + q) / 2)) /
          (Real.sqrt ((1 + p) / 2) * Real.sqrt ((1 + q) / 2)) =
        (c / 2 * (1 - (p + q) / 2)) /
          (Real.sqrt ((1 - p) / 2) * Real.sqrt ((1 - q) / 2))) :
    (1 + (p + q) / 2) / Real.sqrt ((1 + p) * (1 + q)) =
      (1 - (p + q) / 2) / Real.sqrt ((1 - p) * (1 - q))

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.plus_neighbor_inner
statement:
theorem plus_neighbor_inner {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (y : Cube n) (i : Fin n) :
    plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ
      plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i))) =
      root ρ / 2 * (1 + ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y +
        (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f (Function.update y i (!(y i)))) / 2)

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.plus_norm_sq
statement:
theorem plus_norm_sq {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (K : UniformChannel Ω) (y : Ω) :
    plusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ plusVector f K y = (1 + K.apply f y) / 2

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.posterior_abs_constant_of_component_gram
statement:
theorem posterior_abs_constant_of_component_gram {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (hgram : ∀ y z : Cube n,
      (plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) z) /
        (Real.sqrt (plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y) *
          Real.sqrt (plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) z ⬝ᵥ plusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) z)) =
      (minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) z) /
        (Real.sqrt (minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y) *
          Real.sqrt (minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) z ⬝ᵥ minusVector f (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) z))) :
    ∀ y z, |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y| = |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f z|

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.posterior_abs_constant_of_lifting_equality
statement:
theorem posterior_abs_constant_of_lifting_equality {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (heq : TraceNorm.traceNorm
      (averageProjection (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) -
        reflection f * averageProjection (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) * reflection f) / 2 =
        mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y))) :
    ∀ y z, |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y| = |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f z|

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.posterior_neighbor_product
statement:
theorem posterior_neighbor_product {n : ℕ} (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (y x : Cube n) (i : Fin n) :
    posteriorVector (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) y x *
      posteriorVector (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (Function.update y i (!(y i))) x =
      root ρ / 2 * ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight y x +
        (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight (Function.update y i (!(y i))) x)

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.posterior_strict_bounds
statement:
theorem posterior_strict_bounds {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρlt : ρ < 1) (y : Cube n) :
    -1 < (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y ∧ (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y < 1

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.pureDifference_components
statement:
theorem pureDifference_components {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (K : UniformChannel Ω) (y : Ω) :
    MatrixLifting.pureDifference (posteriorVector K y)
      (reflectedVector f (posteriorVector K y)) =
      (2 : ℝ) • (Matrix.vecMulVec (plusVector f K y) (minusVector f K y) +
        Matrix.vecMulVec (minusVector f K y) (plusVector f K y))

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.root_eq_two_component_norms
statement:
theorem root_eq_two_component_norms {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (K : UniformChannel Ω) (y : Ω) :
    root (K.apply f y) =
      2 * Real.sqrt (plusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ plusVector f K y) *
        Real.sqrt (minusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f K y)

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.signed_dictator_coordinate_in_support
statement:
theorem signed_dictator_coordinate_in_support {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) (a : ℝ) (ha : a = 1 ∨ a = -1)
    (hform : ∀ x, f x = a * boolSign (x i)) (v : Cube n)
    (hv : ∀ x, f (translate v x) = -f x) : i ∈ support v

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.signed_dictator_of_lifting_and_objective_equality
statement:
theorem signed_dictator_of_lifting_and_objective_equality {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hm : mean f = 0)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (hlift : TraceNorm.traceNorm
      (ProductState.state n (root ρ) -
        reflection f * ProductState.state n (root ρ) * reflection f) / 2 =
        mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y)))
    (hobj : objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) = 1 - root ρ) :
    ∃ i : Fin n, ∃ a : ℝ, (a = 1 ∨ a = -1) ∧
      ∀ x, f x = a * boolSign (x i)

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.sqrt_half_product
statement:
theorem sqrt_half_product (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    Real.sqrt (a / 2) * Real.sqrt (b / 2) = Real.sqrt (a * b) / 2

name: Hellinger.PosteriorGram.weighted_component_roots
statement:
theorem weighted_component_roots {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (K : UniformChannel Ω) :
    (2 : ℝ) * ∑ y, (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        Real.sqrt (plusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ plusVector f K y) *
        Real.sqrt (minusVector f K y ⬝ᵥ minusVector f K y) =
      mean (fun y => root (K.apply f y))

name: Hellinger.AntipodalEquality.objective_equality_iff_signed_dictator
statement:
theorem objective_equality_iff_signed_dictator (n : ℕ) (f : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode (n + 1) x) = -f x)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1) :
    objective ((cubeBSC (n + 1) ρ hρ).apply f) = 1 - root ρ ↔
      ∃ i : Fin (n + 1), ∃ negative : Bool,
        f = fun x => if negative then -boolSign (x i) else boolSign (x i)

name: Hellinger.AntipodalEquality.root_mean_equality_iff_signed_dictator
statement:
theorem root_mean_equality_iff_signed_dictator (n : ℕ) (f : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode (n + 1) x) = -f x)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1) :
    mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC (n + 1) ρ hρ).apply f y)) = root ρ ↔
      ∃ i : Fin (n + 1), ∃ negative : Bool,
        f = fun x => if negative then -boolSign (x i) else boolSign (x i)

name: Hellinger.UniformChannel.root_apply_equality_iff
statement:
theorem root_apply_equality_iff (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (y : Ω)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < K.weight y x) :
    root (K.apply f y) = K.apply (fun x => root (f x)) y ↔
      ∀ x z, f x = f z

name: Hellinger.UniformChannel.root_mean_equality_iff
statement:
theorem root_mean_equality_iff [Nonempty Ω] (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hpos : ∀ y x, 0 < K.weight y x) :
    mean (fun y => root (K.apply f y)) = mean (fun x => root (f x)) ↔
      ∀ x z, f x = f z

name: Hellinger.eq_of_mean_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem eq_of_mean_eq_of_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (f g : ι → ℝ) (hle : ∀ i, f i ≤ g i) (heq : mean f = mean g) :
    ∀ i, f i = g i

name: Hellinger.root_strictConcave
statement: theorem root_strictConcave : StrictConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) root

name: Hellinger.root_sum_equality_iff
statement:
theorem root_sum_equality_iff {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (w p : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hsum : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    root (∑ i, w i * p i) = (∑ i, w i * root (p i)) ↔
      ∀ i j, p i = p j

name: Hellinger.TranslationEquality.cubeBSC_injective
statement:
theorem cubeBSC_injective (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hρpos : 0 < ρ) : Function.Injective (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply

name: Hellinger.TranslationEquality.indexedBSC_injective
statement:
theorem indexedBSC_injective (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) :
    Function.Injective (indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).apply

name: Hellinger.TranslationEquality.indexedBSC_weight_pos
statement:
theorem indexedBSC_weight_pos (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (x y : ι → Bool) : 0 < (indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).weight x y

name: Hellinger.TranslationEquality.indexed_antipodal_root_equality
statement:
theorem indexed_antipodal_root_equality [Nonempty ι]
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (fun i => !(x i)) = -f x)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (heq : mean (fun y => root ((indexedBSC ι ρ hρ).apply f y)) = root ρ) :
    ∃ i : ι, ∃ negative : Bool,
      f = fun x => if negative then -boolSign (x i) else boolSign (x i)

name: Hellinger.TranslationEquality.sections_equal_of_root_mean_equality
statement:
theorem sections_equal_of_root_mean_equality
    (K : UniformChannel Ω) (L : UniformChannel Λ)
    (f : Ω × Λ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ p, f p ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hpos : ∀ y x, 0 < L.weight y x)
    (heq : mean (fun p => root ((productChannel K L).apply f p)) =
      mean (fun z => mean (fun y => root (K.apply (fun x => f (x, z)) y)))) :
    ∀ y z w, K.apply (fun x => f (x, z)) y = K.apply (fun x => f (x, w)) y

name: Hellinger.TranslationEquality.sections_of_bound_equality
statement:
theorem sections_of_bound_equality (K : UniformChannel Ω) (L : UniformChannel Λ)
    (f : Ω × Λ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ p, f p ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hpos : ∀ y x, 0 < L.weight y x) (c : ℝ)
    (hsec : ∀ z, c ≤ mean (fun y => root (K.apply (fun x => f (x, z)) y)))
    (heq : mean (fun p => root ((productChannel K L).apply f p)) = c) :
    (∀ z, mean (fun y => root (K.apply (fun x => f (x, z)) y)) = c) ∧
      ∀ y z w, K.apply (fun x => f (x, z)) y = K.apply (fun x => f (x, w)) y

name: Hellinger.TranslationEquality.translation_equality
statement: theorem translation_equality : PaperSpecs.TranslationEquality

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.bits_flip_support
statement:
theorem bits_flip_support {n : ℕ} (v : Cube n) (x : PaperSpecs.Cube n) :
    bitsEquiv (Fin n) (PaperSpecs.flip (support v) x) = bitsEquiv (Fin n) x + v

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.constant_objective
statement:
theorem constant_objective {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (K : UniformChannel Ω) (c : ℝ) : objective (K.apply (fun _ => c)) = 0

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.paper_quadratic_hellinger
statement: theorem paper_quadratic_hellinger : PaperSpecs.QuadraticHellinger

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.phase_hellinger
statement:
theorem phase_hellinger {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    PaperSpecs.HellingerBound (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) ρ hρ ∧
    (0 < ρ → ρ < 1 →
      (objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))) = 1 - root ρ ↔
        PaperSpecs.SignedDictatorOn (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) Finset.univ))

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.quotient_phase_bound
statement:
theorem quotient_phase_bound {n k : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n) (Q₀ : Form k)
    (L : Cube n →ₗ[F2] Cube k) (hL : Function.Surjective L)
    (hQ₀ : Q₀.polarBilin.ker = ⊥) (hf : phase a Q = phase a Q₀ ∘ L)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    PaperSpecs.HellingerBound (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) ρ hρ ∧
    (0 < ρ → objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply
      (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))) < 1 - root ρ)

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.root_le_one
statement: theorem root_le_one (ρ : ℝ) : root ρ ≤ 1

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.root_lt_one
statement: theorem root_lt_one (ρ : ℝ) (hp : 0 < ρ) : root ρ < 1

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.support_nonempty
statement: theorem support_nonempty {n : ℕ} (v : Cube n) (hv : v ≠ 0) : (support v).Nonempty

name: Hellinger.AllQuadratic.translation_phase_bound
statement:
theorem translation_phase_bound {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n) (v : Cube n)
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hanti : ∀ x, phase a Q (x + v) = -phase a Q x)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    PaperSpecs.HellingerBound (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) ρ hρ ∧
    (0 < ρ → ρ < 1 →
      (objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n))) = 1 - root ρ ↔
        PaperSpecs.SignedDictatorOn (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) Finset.univ))

name: Hellinger.BentFourClassification.bent_isQuadratic
statement:
theorem bent_isQuadratic (f : Fourier.Cube 4 → ℝ) (hf : PaperSpecs.IsBoolean f)
    (hb : Flatness.IsBent f) : PaperSpecs.IsQuadratic f

name: Hellinger.BentFourClassification.quadraticPhase_isQuadratic
statement:
theorem quadraticPhase_isQuadratic (c : ℝ) (l : Fin 4 → ℝ) (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hc : c ^ 2 = 1) (hl : ∀ i, l i ^ 2 = 1) (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1) :
    PaperSpecs.IsQuadratic (quadraticPhase c l e)

name: Hellinger.BentFourClassification.sign_signCode
statement: theorem sign_signCode (r : ℝ) (hr : r ^ 2 = 1) : sign (signCode r) = r

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.dualForm_polar
statement:
theorem dualForm_polar {n : ℕ} (Q : Form n) (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det)
    (x y : Cube n) :
    (dualForm Q).polarBilin x y = x ⬝ᵥ (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹ *ᵥ y

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.noiseWeight_bits
statement:
theorem noiseWeight_bits {n : ℕ} (ρ : ℝ) (x : Fourier.Cube n) :
    noiseWeight ρ (bitsEquiv (Fin n) x) = ρ ^ Fourier.degree x

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.noise_fourth_moment
statement:
theorem noise_fourth_moment {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (f ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) x) ^ 4) =
      ∑ s : Cube n, (∑ x : Cube n, (noiseWeight ρ x * walsh f x) *
        (noiseWeight ρ (x + s) * walsh f (x + s))) ^ 2

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.phase_fourth_moment
statement:
theorem phase_fourth_moment {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) x) ^ 4) =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ s : Cube n,
        (∑ x : Cube n, noiseWeight ρ x * noiseWeight ρ (x + s) *
          sign (x ⬝ᵥ (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹ *ᵥ s)) ^ 2

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.phase_translation
statement:
theorem phase_translation {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n) (x v : Cube n) :
    phase a Q (x + v) = phase a Q x * sign (Q v) * sign (Q.polarBilin x v)

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.polarMatrix_bilin
statement:
theorem polarMatrix_bilin {n : ℕ} (Q : Form n) (x y : Cube n) :
    x ⬝ᵥ polarMatrix Q *ᵥ y = Q.polarBilin x y

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.polarMatrix_characterization
statement:
theorem polarMatrix_characterization {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n) (x v : Cube n) :
    (a + Q (x + v)) + (a + Q x) + (a + Q v) + (a + Q 0) =
      x ⬝ᵥ polarMatrix Q *ᵥ v

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.polarMatrix_kernel
statement:
theorem polarMatrix_kernel {n : ℕ} (Q : Form n) (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) :
    Q.polarBilin.ker = ⊥

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.polarMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem polarMatrix_mulVec {n : ℕ} (Q : Form n) (y : Cube n) (i : Fin n) :
    (polarMatrix Q *ᵥ y) i = Q.polarBilin (Pi.single i 1) y

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.polarMatrix_symmetric
statement: theorem polarMatrix_symmetric {n : ℕ} (Q : Form n) : (polarMatrix Q).IsSymm

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.sign_dot_bits
statement:
theorem sign_dot_bits {n : ℕ} (s x : Fourier.Cube n) :
    sign (bitsEquiv (Fin n) s ⬝ᵥ bitsEquiv (Fin n) x) = Fourier.phase s x

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.sign_sum
statement:
theorem sign_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (z : ι → F2) :
    sign (∑ i ∈ s, z i) = ∏ i ∈ s, sign (z i)

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.walsh_bits
statement:
theorem walsh_bits {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ) (s : Fourier.Cube n) :
    walsh f (bitsEquiv (Fin n) s) = Fourier.walsh (f ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) s

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.walsh_phase
statement:
theorem walsh_phase {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) (s : Cube n) :
    walsh (phase a Q) s = walsh (phase a Q) 0 * sign (Q ((polarMatrix Q)⁻¹ *ᵥ s))

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.walsh_phase_pair
statement:
theorem walsh_phase_pair {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) (x s : Cube n) :
    walsh (phase a Q) x * walsh (phase a Q) (x + s) =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * sign (dualForm Q s) *
        sign (x ⬝ᵥ (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹ *ᵥ s)

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.walsh_phase_zero_sq
statement:
theorem walsh_phase_zero_sq {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) :
    walsh (phase a Q) 0 ^ 2 = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹

name: Hellinger.QuadraticDual.walsh_zero
statement: theorem walsh_zero {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ) : walsh f 0 = mean f

name: Hellinger.RankCharacterSum.coordinate_character_sum
statement:
theorem coordinate_character_sum (v : F2) :
    (∑ x : F2, sign (x * v)) = if v = 0 then (2 : ℝ) else 0

name: Hellinger.RankCharacterSum.double_character_sum
statement:
theorem double_character_sum (B : Matrix ι ι F2) :
    (∑ s : ι → F2, ∑ d : ι → F2, sign (d ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ s)) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * Fintype.card ι - B.rank)

name: Hellinger.RankCharacterSum.kernel_card
statement:
theorem kernel_card (B : Matrix ι ι F2) :
    Fintype.card B.mulVecLin.ker = 2 ^ (Fintype.card ι - B.rank)

name: Hellinger.RankCharacterSum.sum_character
statement:
theorem sum_character (v : ι → F2) :
    (∑ x : ι → F2, sign (x ⬝ᵥ v)) = if v = 0 then (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι else 0

name: Hellinger.PrincipalSubspaces.embed_bilin
statement:
theorem embed_bilin {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F2)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x y : S → F2) :
    embed S x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ embed S y = x ⬝ᵥ principalMatrix B S *ᵥ y

name: Hellinger.PrincipalSubspaces.embed_dot
statement:
theorem embed_dot {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : S → F2) (v : Cube n) :
    embed S x ⬝ᵥ v = ∑ i : S, x i * v i

name: Hellinger.PrincipalSubspaces.embed_supported
statement: theorem embed_supported {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : S → F2) : Supported S (embed S x)

name: Hellinger.PrincipalSubspaces.mulVec_embed
statement:
theorem mulVec_embed {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F2)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) (y : S → F2) (i : Fin n) :
    (B *ᵥ embed S y) i = ∑ j : S, B i j * y j

name: Hellinger.PrincipalSubspaces.principal_character_sum
statement:
theorem principal_character_sum {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F2)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (∑ s : Cube n, ∑ d : Cube n,
      if Supported S s ∧ Supported S d then sign (d ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ s) else 0) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * S.card - (principalMatrix B S).rank)

name: Hellinger.PrincipalSubspaces.sum_supported
statement:
theorem sum_supported {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (F : Cube n → ℝ) :
    (∑ v : Cube n, if Supported S v then F v else 0) = ∑ x : S → F2, F (embed S x)

name: Hellinger.RankMomentExpansion.char_add
statement:
theorem char_add {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F2) (x y s : Cube n) :
    sign ((x + y) ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ s) = sign (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ s) * sign (y ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ s)

name: Hellinger.RankMomentExpansion.coordinate_four_weights
statement:
theorem coordinate_four_weights (ρ : ℝ) (s d : F2) :
    (∑ x : F2, weightBit ρ x * weightBit ρ (x + s) *
      weightBit ρ (x + d) * weightBit ρ (x + d + s)) =
    2 * ρ ^ 2 + (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ 2 * (if s = 0 ∧ d = 0 then 1 else 0)

name: Hellinger.RankMomentExpansion.four_weights_sum
statement:
theorem four_weights_sum {n : ℕ} (ρ : ℝ) (s d : Cube n) :
    (∑ x : Cube n, noiseWeight ρ x * noiseWeight ρ (x + s) *
      noiseWeight ρ (x + d) * noiseWeight ρ (x + d + s)) =
    ∏ i, (2 * ρ ^ 2 + (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ 2 * (if s i = 0 ∧ d i = 0 then 1 else 0))

name: Hellinger.RankMomentExpansion.phase_fourth_coordinate_expansion
statement:
theorem phase_fourth_coordinate_expansion {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) x) ^ 4) =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ s : Cube n, ∑ d : Cube n,
        sign (d ⬝ᵥ (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹ *ᵥ s) *
          ∏ i, (2 * ρ ^ 2 + (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ 2 * (if s i = 0 ∧ d i = 0 then 1 else 0))

name: Hellinger.RankMomentExpansion.sum_f2
statement: theorem sum_f2 (f : F2 → ℝ) : (∑ x, f x) = f 0 + f 1

name: Hellinger.RankMomentExpansion.weighted_character_square
statement:
theorem weighted_character_square {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F2)
    (ρ : ℝ) (s : Cube n) :
    (∑ x : Cube n, noiseWeight ρ x * noiseWeight ρ (x + s) *
      sign (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ s)) ^ 2 =
    ∑ d : Cube n, sign (d ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ s) *
      ∏ i, (2 * ρ ^ 2 + (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ 2 * (if s i = 0 ∧ d i = 0 then 1 else 0))

name: Hellinger.PrincipalRankMoment.coordinate_product_expansion
statement:
theorem coordinate_product_expansion {n : ℕ} (t : ℝ) (s d : Cube n) :
    (∏ i, (2 * t + (1 - t) ^ 2 * (if s i = 0 ∧ d i = 0 then 1 else 0))) =
      ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), rankWeight t S *
        (if Supported S s ∧ Supported S d then 1 else 0)

name: Hellinger.PrincipalRankMoment.fourth_moment_principal_ranks
statement:
theorem fourth_moment_principal_ranks {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) x) ^ 4) =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * n))⁻¹ * ∑ S : Finset (Fin n),
        (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ (2 * (n - S.card)) * (2 * ρ ^ 2) ^ S.card *
          (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * S.card - (principalMatrix (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹ S).rank)

name: Hellinger.PrincipalRankMoment.fourth_moment_quadratic_value
statement:
theorem fourth_moment_quadratic_value {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (b : Fin n → F2)
    (q : Fin n → Fin n → F2) (f : PaperSpecs.Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = if PaperSpecs.quadraticValue a b q x = 0 then 1 else -1)
    (hQ : (polarMatrix (polynomial b q)).det ≠ 0)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x) ^ 4) =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * n))⁻¹ * ∑ S : Finset (Fin n),
        (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ (2 * (n - S.card)) * (2 * ρ ^ 2) ^ S.card *
          (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * S.card -
            (principalMatrix (polarMatrix (polynomial b q))⁻¹ S).rank)

name: Hellinger.PrincipalRankMoment.outside_indicator
statement:
theorem outside_indicator {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (s d : Cube n) :
    (∏ i ∈ Sᶜ, if s i = 0 ∧ d i = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      if Supported S s ∧ Supported S d then 1 else 0

name: Hellinger.PrincipalRankMoment.rank_sum_expansion
statement:
theorem rank_sum_expansion {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F2) (t : ℝ) :
    (∑ s : Cube n, ∑ d : Cube n, sign (d ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ s) *
      ∏ i, (2 * t + (1 - t) ^ 2 * (if s i = 0 ∧ d i = 0 then 1 else 0))) =
      ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), rankWeight t S *
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * S.card - (principalMatrix B S).rank)

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.fourth_moment_graph_interlace
statement:
theorem fourth_moment_graph_interlace {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hρlt : ρ < 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) x) ^ 4) =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * n))⁻¹ * (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ (2 * n) *
        graphInterlace (inversePolarGraph Q hQ) (1 + 4 * ρ ^ 2 / (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ 2)
          (1 + 8 * ρ ^ 2 / (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.fourth_moment_interlace
statement:
theorem fourth_moment_interlace {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hρlt : ρ < 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) x) ^ 4) =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * n))⁻¹ * (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ (2 * n) *
        interlace (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹ (1 + 4 * ρ ^ 2 / (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ 2)
          (1 + 8 * ρ ^ 2 / (1 - ρ ^ 2) ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.interlace_substitution
statement:
theorem interlace_substitution {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F2)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 1) :
    (1 - t) ^ (2 * n) * interlace B (1 + 4 * t / (1 - t) ^ 2)
      (1 + 8 * t / (1 - t) ^ 2) =
      ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), rankWeight t S *
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * S.card - (principalMatrix B S).rank)

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.inversePolarGraph_adjacency
statement:
theorem inversePolarGraph_adjacency {n : ℕ} (Q : Form n) (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) :
    (inversePolarGraph Q hQ).adjMatrix F2 = (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.inverse_polar_alternating
statement:
theorem inverse_polar_alternating {n : ℕ} (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) (x : Cube n) :
    x ⬝ᵥ (polarMatrix Q)⁻¹ *ᵥ x = 0

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.inverse_polar_isAdjMatrix
statement:
theorem inverse_polar_isAdjMatrix {n : ℕ} (Q : Form n)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) : ((polarMatrix Q)⁻¹).IsAdjMatrix

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.noise_one
statement:
theorem noise_one {n : ℕ} (f : Fourier.Cube n → ℝ)
    (h₁ : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : (cubeBSC n 1 h₁).apply f = f

name: Hellinger.InterlaceMoment.phase_fourth_moment_one
statement:
theorem phase_fourth_moment_one {n : ℕ} (a : F2) (Q : Form n)
    (h₁ : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC n 1 h₁).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin n)) x) ^ 4) = 1

name: Hellinger.BentFourEdgeCount.derivative_moment_edge_count
statement:
theorem derivative_moment_edge_count (e : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (he : ∀ i, e i ^ 2 = 1) (hnd : EdgeNondegenerate e) (ρ : ℝ) :
    2 ≤ negativeEdges e ∧ (∑ s : Cube 4, noiseDerivativeSum e ρ s ^ 2) =
      256 * BentEstimates.fourthMomentExpression (negativeEdges e) (ρ ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.BentFourMatrix.edgeAction_matrix
statement:
theorem edgeAction_matrix (B : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) F2)
    (hB : B.IsSymm) (hd : ∀ i, B i i = 0) (s : Fourier.Cube 4) (i : Fin 4) :
    edgeAction (edgeSigns B) s i = sign ((B *ᵥ bitsEquiv (Fin 4) s) i)

name: Hellinger.BentFourMatrix.edgeSigns_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem edgeSigns_nondegenerate (B : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) F2)
    (hB : B.IsSymm) (hd : ∀ i, B i i = 0) (hdet : IsUnit B.det) :
    EdgeNondegenerate (edgeSigns B)

name: Hellinger.BentFourMatrix.edgeSigns_sq
statement:
theorem edgeSigns_sq (B : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) F2) (i : Fin 6) :
    edgeSigns B i ^ 2 = 1

name: Hellinger.BentFourMatrix.fourth_moment_actual_edges
statement:
theorem fourth_moment_actual_edges (a : F2) (Q : Form 4)
    (hQ : IsUnit (polarMatrix Q).det) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    2 ≤ upperEdgeCount ((polarMatrix Q)⁻¹) ∧
    mean (fun x => ((cubeBSC 4 ρ hρ).apply (phase a Q ∘ bitsEquiv (Fin 4)) x) ^ 4) =
      BentEstimates.fourthMomentExpression (upperEdgeCount ((polarMatrix Q)⁻¹)) (ρ ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.BentFourMatrix.matrix_character_sum
statement:
theorem matrix_character_sum (B : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) F2)
    (hB : B.IsSymm) (hd : ∀ i, B i i = 0) (ρ : ℝ) (s : Fourier.Cube 4) :
    (∑ x : Cube 4, noiseWeight ρ x * noiseWeight ρ (x + bitsEquiv (Fin 4) s) *
      sign (x ⬝ᵥ B *ᵥ bitsEquiv (Fin 4) s)) = noiseDerivativeSum (edgeSigns B) ρ s

name: Hellinger.BentFourMatrix.negativeEdges_eq_upperEdgeCount
statement:
theorem negativeEdges_eq_upperEdgeCount (B : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) F2) :
    BentFourEdgeCount.negativeEdges (edgeSigns B) = upperEdgeCount B

name: Hellinger.BentFourMatrix.sign_dot_character
statement:
theorem sign_dot_character (x : Fourier.Cube 4) (v : Cube 4) :
    sign (bitsEquiv (Fin 4) x ⬝ᵥ v) = signCharacter (fun i => sign (v i)) x

name: Hellinger.BentFourMatrix.sign_mul_bit
statement:
theorem sign_mul_bit (z : F2) (b : Bool) :
    sign (z * bitEquiv b) = if b then sign z else 1

name: Hellinger.BentLowExact.alpha_bounds
statement:
theorem alpha_bounds (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hmax : α ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ)) : α ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ (n : ℝ) * α ≤ 1

name: Hellinger.BentLowExact.coefficient_le
statement:
theorem coefficient_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hmax : α ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ)) :
    (1 - α) ^ (((n : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * Real.sqrt (1 - (n : ℝ) * α) ≤
      (1 - α) ^ (n - 1)

name: Hellinger.BentLowExact.manuscript_low_noise
statement:
theorem manuscript_low_noise {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hmax : α ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ))
    (hρ : 1 - 2 * α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun x => root ((cubeBSC n (1 - 2 * α) hρ).apply f x)) /
        (2 * Real.sqrt (α * (1 - α))) ≥
      (1 - α) ^ (((n : ℝ) - 2) / 2) * Real.sqrt (1 - (n : ℝ) * α) *
        mean (fun x => Real.sqrt (Flatness.sensitivity f x))

name: Hellinger.BentLowExact.manuscript_low_noise_full
statement:
theorem manuscript_low_noise_full {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hmax : α ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ)) :
    let hρ : 1 - 2 * α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      obtain ⟨hhalf, _⟩

name: Hellinger.ProductDisintegration.conditional_expectation_productKernel
statement:
theorem conditional_expectation_productKernel (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (Y i ω, B i ω)) μ) :
    μ[fun ω => f (fun i => B i ω) | MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω i => Y i ω) inferInstance]
      =ᵐ[μ] fun ω => ∫ b, f b ∂productKernel
        (fun i => condDistrib (B i) (Y i) μ) (fun i => Y i ω)

name: Hellinger.ProductDisintegration.independent_output_law
statement:
theorem independent_output_law
    (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (Y i ω, B i ω)) μ) :
    μ.map (fun ω i => Y i ω) = Measure.pi (fun i => μ.map (Y i))

name: Hellinger.ProductDisintegration.independent_pair_disintegration
statement:
theorem independent_pair_disintegration
    (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (Y i ω, B i ω)) μ) :
    μ.map (fun ω => ((fun i => Y i ω), (fun i => B i ω))) =
      (Measure.pi (fun i => μ.map (Y i))) ⊗ₘ
        productKernel (fun i => condDistrib (B i) (Y i) μ)

name: Hellinger.ProductDisintegration.lintegral_fin_prod
statement:
theorem lintegral_fin_prod {n : ℕ} {X : Fin n → Type*}
    [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (X i)] (ν : (i : Fin n) → Measure (X i)) [∀ i, SigmaFinite (ν i)]
    (f : (i : Fin n) → X i → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : ∀ i, Measurable (f i)) :
    (∫⁻ x, ∏ i, f i (x i) ∂Measure.pi ν) = ∏ i, ∫⁻ z, f i z ∂ν i

name: Hellinger.ProductDisintegration.lintegral_fintype_prod
statement:
theorem lintegral_fintype_prod (ν : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)) [∀ i, SigmaFinite (ν i)]
    (f : (i : ι) → E i → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : ∀ i, Measurable (f i)) :
    (∫⁻ x, ∏ i, f i (x i) ∂Measure.pi ν) = ∏ i, ∫⁻ z, f i z ∂ν i

name: Hellinger.ProductDisintegration.pi_compProd
statement:
theorem pi_compProd (ν : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (κ : (i : ι) → Kernel (E i) Bool) [∀ i, IsMarkovKernel (κ i)] :
    ((Measure.pi ν) ⊗ₘ productKernel κ).map (groupEquiv (E := E)).symm =
      Measure.pi (fun i => ν i ⊗ₘ κ i)

name: Hellinger.ProductDisintegration.productKernel_ae_condDistrib
statement:
theorem productKernel_ae_condDistrib
    (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (Y i ω, B i ω)) μ) :
    productKernel (fun i => condDistrib (B i) (Y i) μ) =ᵐ[μ.map (fun ω i => Y i ω)]
      condDistrib (fun ω i => B i ω) (fun ω i => Y i ω) μ

name: Hellinger.ProductDisintegration.productKernel_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem productKernel_apply (κ : (i : ι) → Kernel (E i) Bool)
    [∀ i, IsMarkovKernel (κ i)] (y : (i : ι) → E i) :
    productKernel κ y = Measure.pi (fun i => κ i (y i))

name: Hellinger.ProductDisintegration.productKernel_singleton
Hellinger.DiscreteBayes.bayes_singleton
statement:
theorem bayes_singleton (hB : Measurable B) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hfair : μ.map B = (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).toMeasure) (y : E) (b : Bool) :
    (μ.map Y).real {y} * (condDistrib B Y μ y).real {b} =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (condDistrib Y B μ b).real {y}

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.antipodal_trace_lower_bound
statement:
theorem antipodal_trace_lower_bound (n : ℕ) (z : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hcz : ∀ i, c ≤ z i) (f : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (hanti : ∀ x, f (antipode (n + 1) x) = -f x) :
    c ≤ traceNorm (state (n + 1) z - reflection f * state (n + 1) z * reflection f) / 2

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.bool_mixture_phase
statement:
theorem bool_mixture_phase (η : ℝ) (hη : η ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x y : Bool) :
    (∑ s : Bool, (bsc η hη).weight false s * boolSign (s && x) * boolSign (s && y)) =
      if x = y then 1 else η

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.dephase_entry
statement:
theorem dephase_entry (n : ℕ) (η : Fin n → ℝ) (hη : ∀ i, η i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ) (x y : Cube n) :
    dephase n η hη A x y = (∏ i, if x i = y i then 1 else η i) * A x y

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.dephase_reflection
statement:
theorem dephase_reflection (n : ℕ) (η : Fin n → ℝ) (hη : ∀ i, η i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (f : Cube n → ℝ) (A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ) :
    dephase n η hη (reflection f * A * reflection f) =
      reflection f * dephase n η hη A * reflection f

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.dephase_state
statement:
theorem dephase_state (n : ℕ) (η : Fin n → ℝ) (hη : ∀ i, η i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (z : Fin n → ℝ) : dephase n η hη (state n z) = state n (fun i => η i * z i)

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.dephase_sub
statement:
theorem dephase_sub (n : ℕ) (η : Fin n → ℝ) (hη : ∀ i, η i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (A B : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ) :
    dephase n η hη (A - B) = dephase n η hη A - dephase n η hη B

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.dephase_traceNorm_le
statement:
theorem dephase_traceNorm_le (n : ℕ) (η : Fin n → ℝ) (hη : ∀ i, η i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    traceNorm (dephase n η hη A) ≤ traceNorm A

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.mixture_phase
statement:
theorem mixture_phase (n : ℕ) (η : Fin n → ℝ) (hη : ∀ i, η i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (x y : Cube n) :
    (∑ s, mixtureWeight n η hη s * phase s x * phase s y) =
      ∏ i, if x i = y i then 1 else η i

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.phaseConjugate_entry
statement:
theorem phaseConjugate_entry {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n) (A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ)
    (x y : Cube n) : phaseConjugate s A x y = phase s x * A x y * phase s y

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.phaseConjugate_eq
statement:
theorem phaseConjugate_eq {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n) (A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ) :
    phaseConjugate s A = Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (phaseUnitary s) A

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.phaseConjugate_isHermitian
statement:
theorem phaseConjugate_isHermitian {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n)
    {A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (phaseConjugate s A).IsHermitian

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.phaseMatrix_sq
statement: theorem phaseMatrix_sq {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n) : phaseMatrix s * phaseMatrix s = 1

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.phaseMatrix_star
statement: theorem phaseMatrix_star {n : ℕ} (s : Cube n) : star (phaseMatrix s) = phaseMatrix s

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.reflection_isHermitian
statement:
theorem reflection_isHermitian {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    {A : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (reflection f * A * reflection f).IsHermitian

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.state_const
statement: theorem state_const (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : state n (fun _ => c) = ProductState.state n c

name: Hellinger.HeterogeneousState.state_isHermitian
statement: theorem state_isHermitian (n : ℕ) (z : Fin n → ℝ) : (state n z).IsHermitian

name: Hellinger.IntegralLifting.integral_pure_lifting
statement:
theorem integral_pure_lifting (μ : Measure Ω) (v w : Ω → ι → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ y, v y ⬝ᵥ v y = 1) (hw : ∀ y, w y ⬝ᵥ w y = 1)
    (hentry : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => pureDifference (v y) (w y) i j) μ)
    (hroot : Integrable (fun y => root (v y ⬝ᵥ w y)) μ) :
    traceNorm (matrixIntegral μ (fun y => pureDifference (v y) (w y))) / 2 ≤
      ∫ y, root (v y ⬝ᵥ w y) ∂μ

name: Hellinger.IntegralLifting.matrixIntegral_isHermitian
statement:
theorem matrixIntegral_isHermitian (μ : Measure Ω) (A : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ y, (A y).IsHermitian) : (matrixIntegral μ A).IsHermitian

name: Hellinger.IntegralLifting.matrixIntegral_reflection
statement:
theorem matrixIntegral_reflection (μ : Measure Ω) (A : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    matrixIntegral μ (fun y => reflection f * A y * reflection f) =
      reflection f * matrixIntegral μ A * reflection f

name: Hellinger.IntegralLifting.matrixIntegral_sub
statement:
theorem matrixIntegral_sub (μ : Measure Ω) (A B : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => A y i j) μ)
    (hB : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => B y i j) μ) :
    matrixIntegral μ (fun y => A y - B y) = matrixIntegral μ A - matrixIntegral μ B

name: Hellinger.IntegralLifting.traceNorm_matrixIntegral_le
statement:
theorem traceNorm_matrixIntegral_le (μ : Measure Ω) (A : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => A y i j) μ)
    (hAH : ∀ y, (A y).IsHermitian) (g : Ω → ℝ) (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hbound : ∀ y, traceNorm (A y) ≤ g y) :
    traceNorm (matrixIntegral μ A) ≤ ∫ y, g y ∂μ

name: Hellinger.IntegralLifting.trace_mul_integrable
statement:
theorem trace_mul_integrable (μ : Measure Ω) (A : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => A y i j) μ) (Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun y => (Q * A y).trace) μ

name: Hellinger.IntegralLifting.trace_mul_matrixIntegral
statement:
theorem trace_mul_matrixIntegral (μ : Measure Ω) (A : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => A y i j) μ) (Q : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    (Q * matrixIntegral μ A).trace = ∫ y, (Q * A y).trace ∂μ

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.antipodal_bound
statement:
theorem antipodal_bound {n : ℕ} {E : Fin (n + 1) → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (E i)]
    (μ : (i : Fin (n + 1)) → Measure (E i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (a : (i : Fin (n + 1)) → E i → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i))
    (hb : ∀ i y, a i y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ y, a i y ∂μ i = 0)
    (f : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ b, f b = -1 ∨ f b = 1)
    (hanti : ∀ b, f (antipode (n + 1) b) = -f b)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hcz : ∀ i, c ≤ parameter μ a i) :
    c ≤ ∫ y, root (posteriorMean a f y) ∂Measure.pi μ

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.arbitrary_output_lifting
statement:
theorem arbitrary_output_lifting (μ : (i : Fin n) → Measure (E i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (a : (i : Fin n) → E i → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i))
    (hb : ∀ i y, a i y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ y, a i y ∂μ i = 0)
    (f : Cube n → ℝ) (hf : ∀ b, f b = -1 ∨ f b = 1) :
    TraceNorm.traceNorm (HeterogeneousState.state n (parameter μ a) -
      reflection f * HeterogeneousState.state n (parameter μ a) * reflection f) / 2 ≤
      ∫ y, root (posteriorMean a f y) ∂Measure.pi μ

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.average_projection
statement:
theorem average_projection (μ : (i : Fin n) → Measure (E i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (a : (i : Fin n) → E i → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i))
    (hb : ∀ i y, a i y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ y, a i y ∂μ i = 0) :
    matrixIntegral (Measure.pi μ) (fun y => Matrix.vecMulVec (vector a y) (vector a y)) =
      HeterogeneousState.state n (parameter μ a)

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.bitProbability_cross
statement:
theorem bitProbability_cross (a : ℝ) (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    Real.sqrt (bitProbability a false) * Real.sqrt (bitProbability a true) = root a / 2

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.bitProbability_integral
statement:
theorem bitProbability_integral {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (a : Ω → ℝ) (ha : Measurable a) (hb : ∀ y, a y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∫ y, a y ∂μ = 0) (b : Bool) : ∫ y, bitProbability (a y) b ∂μ = 1 / 2

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.bitProbability_mem
statement:
theorem bitProbability_mem (a : ℝ) (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (b : Bool) :
    bitProbability a b ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.bitProbability_sum
statement: theorem bitProbability_sum (a : ℝ) : ∑ b : Bool, bitProbability a b = 1

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.coordinate_average
statement:
theorem coordinate_average {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (a : Ω → ℝ) (ha : Measurable a) (hb : ∀ y, a y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∫ y, a y ∂μ = 0) (b c : Bool) :
    (∫ y, Real.sqrt (bitProbability (a y) b) * Real.sqrt (bitProbability (a y) c) ∂μ) =
      ProductState.oneQubit (∫ y, root (a y) ∂μ) b c

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.integrable_of_abs_le
statement:
theorem integrable_of_abs_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f) (C : ℝ) (hC : ∀ y, |f y| ≤ C) : Integrable f μ

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.measurable_posteriorMean
statement:
theorem measurable_posteriorMean (a : (i : Fin n) → E i → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i))
    (f : Cube n → ℝ) : Measurable (posteriorMean a f)

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.measurable_probability
statement:
theorem measurable_probability (a : (i : Fin n) → E i → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i))
    (b : Cube n) : Measurable (fun y => probability a y b)

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.measurable_vector
statement:
theorem measurable_vector (a : (i : Fin n) → E i → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i))
    (b : Cube n) : Measurable (fun y => vector a y b)

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.parameter_mem
statement:
theorem parameter_mem (μ : (i : Fin n) → Measure (E i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (a : (i : Fin n) → E i → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i)) (i : Fin n) :
    parameter μ a i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.posteriorMean_mem
statement:
theorem posteriorMean_mem (a : (i : Fin n) → E i → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ i y, a i y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ b, f b ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (y : (i : Fin n) → E i) :
    posteriorMean a f y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1

name: Hellinger.ProductPosterior.probability_nonneg
statement:
theorem probability_nonneg (a : (i : Fin n) → E i → ℝ)

statement:
theorem indexed_antipodal_bound [Nonempty ι]
    (μ : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]

name: Hellinger.PosteriorSections.probability_split_symm
statement:
theorem probability_split_symm (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (a : (i : ι) → E i → ℝ) (y : (i : ι) → E i)
    (w : {i // p i} → Bool) (z : {i // ¬p i} → Bool) :
    probability a y ((splitCube p).symm (w, z)) =
      probability (fun i : {i // p i} => a i) (fun i => y i) w *
        probability (fun i : {i // ¬p i} => a i) (fun i => y i) z

name: Hellinger.PosteriorSections.probability_sum
statement:
theorem probability_sum (a : (i : ι) → E i → ℝ) (y : (i : ι) → E i) :

name: Hellinger.PosteriorSections.split_flip
statement:
theorem split_flip (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (w : {i // p i} → Bool) (z : {i // ¬p i} → Bool) :
    (splitCube p).symm ((fun i => !(w i)), z) =
      fun i => if p i then !((splitCube p).symm (w, z) i) else (splitCube p).symm (w, z) i

name: Hellinger.PosteriorSections.subset_bound
statement:
theorem subset_bound (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [Nonempty {i // p i}]
    (μ : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (a : (i : ι) → E i → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i))
    (hb : ∀ i y, a i y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ y, a i y ∂μ i = 0)
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ b, f b = -1 ∨ f b = 1)
    (hflip : ∀ b, f (fun i => if p i then !(b i) else b i) = -f b)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hcz : ∀ i, p i → c ≤ parameter μ a i) :
    c ≤ ∫ y, root (value a f y) ∂Measure.pi μ

name: Hellinger.PosteriorSections.subset_sharp
statement:
theorem subset_sharp (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [Nonempty {i // p i}]
    (μ : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
    (a : (i : ι) → E i → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i))
    (hb : ∀ i y, a i y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ y, a i y ∂μ i = 0) :
    ∃ i : {i // p i}, (∀ j : {j // p j}, parameter μ a i ≤ parameter μ a j) ∧
      (∀ f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ, (∀ b, f b = -1 ∨ f b = 1) →
        (∀ b, f (fun j => if p j then !(b j) else b j) = -f b) →
        parameter μ a i ≤ ∫ y, root (value a f y) ∂Measure.pi μ) ∧
      (∀ b : ι → Bool, boolSign ((fun j => if p j then !(b j) else b j) i) = -boolSign (b i)) ∧
      (∫ y, root (value a (fun b => boolSign (b i)) y) ∂Measure.pi μ) = parameter μ a i

statement:

statement:
theorem value_mem (a : (i : ι) → E i → ℝ)

name: Hellinger.PosteriorSections.value_reindex
statement:
theorem value_reindex (e : κ ≃ ι) (a : (i : ι) → E i → ℝ)
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (y : (i : κ) → E (e i)) :
    value (fun i => a (e i)) (f ∘ cubeEquiv e) y =
      value a f (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft E e y)

name: Hellinger.PosteriorSections.value_split
statement:
theorem value_split (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (a : (i : ι) → E i → ℝ) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (y : (i : ι) → E i) :
    value a f y = ∑ z : {i // ¬p i} → Bool,
      probability (fun i : {i // ¬p i} => a i) (fun i => y i) z *
        value (fun i : {i // p i} => a i)
          (fun w => f ((splitCube p).symm (w, z))) (fun i => y i)

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.channelParameter_eq
statement:
theorem channelParameter_eq (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i)) (i : ι) :
    channelParameter μ B Y i =
      PosteriorSections.parameter (outputLaw μ Y) (coordinateBias μ B Y) i

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.coordinate_attains
statement:
theorem coordinate_attains (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (Y i ω, B i ω)) μ) (i : ι) :

statement:

      fun ω => coordinateBias μ B Y i (Y i ω)

statement:

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.independent_channel_bound
statement:
theorem independent_channel_bound (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [Nonempty {i // p i}]
    (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (Y i ω, B i ω)) μ)
    (hfair : ∀ i, μ.map (B i) = (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).toMeasure)
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ b, f b = -1 ∨ f b = 1)
    (hflip : ∀ b, f (fun i => if p i then !(b i) else b i) = -f b)
    (i : {i // p i}) (hmin : ∀ j : {j // p j}, channelParameter μ B Y i ≤ channelParameter μ B Y j) :
    channelParameter μ B Y i ≤ ∫ ω, root (posterior μ B Y f ω) ∂μ

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.independent_channels
statement:
theorem independent_channels (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [Nonempty {i // p i}]
    (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (Y i ω, B i ω)) μ)
    (hfair : ∀ i, μ.map (B i) = (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).toMeasure) :
    ∃ i : {i // p i}, (∀ j : {j // p j}, channelParameter μ B Y i ≤ channelParameter μ B Y j) ∧
      (∀ f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ, (∀ b, f b = -1 ∨ f b = 1) →
        (∀ b, f (fun j => if p j then !(b j) else b j) = -f b) →
        channelParameter μ B Y i ≤ ∫ ω, root (posterior μ B Y f ω) ∂μ) ∧
      (∀ b : ι → Bool, boolSign ((fun j => if p j then !(b j) else b j) i) = -boolSign (b i)) ∧
      (∫ ω, root (posterior μ B Y (fun b => boolSign (b i)) ω) ∂μ) = channelParameter μ B Y i

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.posterior_root_integral
statement:
theorem posterior_root_integral (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (Y i ω, B i ω)) μ) :
    (∫ ω, root (posterior μ B Y f ω) ∂μ) =
      ∫ y, root (PosteriorSections.value (coordinateBias μ B Y) f y)
        ∂Measure.pi (outputLaw μ Y)

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.posterior_value
statement:
theorem posterior_value (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (Y i ω, B i ω)) μ) :
    posterior μ B Y f =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => PosteriorSections.value (coordinateBias μ B Y) f (fun i => Y i ω)

name: Hellinger.IndependentChannels.productKernel_integral
statement:
theorem productKernel_integral {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {E : ι → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (E i)]
    (κ : (i : ι) → Kernel (E i) Bool) [∀ i, IsMarkovKernel (κ i)]
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (y : (i : ι) → E i) :
    (∫ b, f b ∂productKernel κ y) = PosteriorSections.value (fun i => bias (κ i)) f y

name: Hellinger.Bhattacharyya.discrete_channelParameter
statement:
theorem discrete_channelParameter {ι Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {E : ι → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (E i)]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (B : ι → Ω → Bool) (Y : (i : ι) → Ω → E i)
    (hB : ∀ i, Measurable (B i)) (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (hfair : ∀ i, μ.map (B i) = (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).toMeasure)
    (i : ι) [Countable (E i)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (E i)] [Nonempty (E i)] :
    IndependentChannels.channelParameter μ B Y i =
      ∑' y, Real.sqrt ((condDistrib (Y i) (B i) μ false).real {y} *
        (condDistrib (Y i) (B i) μ true).real {y})

name: Hellinger.Bhattacharyya.discrete_parameter
statement:
theorem discrete_parameter {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace E]
    [Countable E] [MeasurableSingletonClass E] [Nonempty E]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (B : Ω → Bool) (Y : Ω → E)
    (hB : Measurable B) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hfair : μ.map B = (PMF.uniformOfFintype Bool).toMeasure) :
    (∫ ω, root (μ[fun ω => boolSign (B ω) | MeasurableSpace.comap Y inferInstance] ω) ∂μ) =
      ∑' y, Real.sqrt ((condDistrib Y B μ false).real {y} *
        (condDistrib Y B μ true).real {y})

name: Hellinger.Bhattacharyya.weighted_root
statement:
theorem weighted_root (q p m P M : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (hsum : p + m = 1) (hP : q * p = P / 2) (hM : q * m = M / 2) :
    q * root (p - m) = Real.sqrt (P * M)

name: Hellinger.EntropyTransfer.information_equality_implies_hellinger_equality
statement:
theorem information_equality_implies_hellinger_equality
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (u : Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ x, u x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hH : objective u ≤ 1 - root ρ)
    (hI : PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - mean u) / 2) -
      mean (fun x => PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - u x) / 2)) =
        1 - PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - ρ) / 2)) :
    objective u = 1 - root ρ

name: Hellinger.EntropyTransfer.information_le_entropy_gap
statement:
theorem information_le_entropy_gap {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (u : Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ x, u x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - mean u) / 2) -
      mean (fun x => PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - u x) / 2)) ≤
        1 - entropyCurveBits (1 - objective u)

name: Hellinger.EntropyTransfer.information_of_hellinger
statement:
theorem information_of_hellinger {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (u : Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ x, u x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hH : objective u ≤ 1 - root ρ) :
    PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - mean u) / 2) -
      mean (fun x => PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - u x) / 2)) ≤
        1 - PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - ρ) / 2)

name: Hellinger.EntropyTransfer.strict_information_of_strict_hellinger

theorem strict_information_of_strict_hellinger {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]

    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hH : objective u < 1 - root ρ) :
    PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - mean u) / 2) -
      mean (fun x => PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - u x) / 2)) <
        1 - PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - ρ) / 2)

theorem anticommuting_uncertainty {F Q : Matrix ι ι ℂ}
    (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hFsq : F * F = 1) (hQ : Q.IsHermitian) (hn : ‖Q‖ ≤ 1)
    (ha : F * Q * F = -Q) (ψ : ι → ℂ) (hψ : ‖toLp 2 ψ‖ = 1) :
    (star ψ ⬝ᵥ F *ᵥ ψ).re ^ 2 + (star ψ ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ ψ).re ^ 2 ≤ 1

    ∃ Q : Matrix ι ι ℂ, Q.IsHermitian ∧ ‖Q‖ ≤ 1 ∧ F * Q * F = -Q ∧
      realTrace (K * Q) = traceNorm (K - F * K * F) / 2

statement:
theorem reflection_counterexample (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ P : Matrix (Cube 3) (Cube 3) ℝ,
      P.IsHermitian ∧ P * P = 1 ∧
      (∀ x, (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ (hadamardUnitary 3) P) x x = 0) ∧
      traceNorm (state 3 c - P * state 3 c * P) / 2 = c * (1 + c ^ 2) / 2 ∧
      c * (1 + c ^ 2) / 2 < c ∧ (∀ f : Cube 3 → ℝ, P ≠ Matrix.diagonal f)

name: Hellinger.ReflectionCounterexample.vec3_last

name: Hellinger.CutNorm.balanced_cards
statement:
theorem balanced_cards [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hm : mean f = 0) :
    Fintype.card (Positive f) = Fintype.card (Negative f)

name: Hellinger.CutNorm.cogram_posSemidef
statement: theorem cogram_posSemidef (A : Matrix ι κ ℝ) : (A * A.transpose).PosSemidef

name: Hellinger.CutNorm.cut_blocks
statement:
theorem cut_blocks (K : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hK : K.IsHermitian)
    (f : ι → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (e : Positive f ≃ Negative f) :
    (K - Matrix.diagonal f * K * Matrix.diagonal f).submatrix (cutEquiv f e) (cutEquiv f e) =
      (2 : ℝ) • Matrix.fromBlocks 0 ((cutMatrix K f).submatrix id e)
        ((cutMatrix K f).submatrix id e).transpose 0

name: Hellinger.CutNorm.cut_trace_identity
statement:
theorem cut_trace_identity [Nonempty ι] (K : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hK : K.IsHermitian)
    (f : ι → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hm : mean f = 0) :
    traceNorm (K - Matrix.diagonal f * K * Matrix.diagonal f) / 2 =
      2 * rectangularTraceNorm (cutMatrix K f)

name: Hellinger.CutNorm.gram_posSemidef
statement: theorem gram_posSemidef (A : Matrix ι κ ℝ) : (A.transpose * A).PosSemidef

name: Hellinger.CutNorm.product_state_cut_identity
statement:
theorem product_state_cut_identity (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) (hm : mean f = 0) :
    traceNorm (state n c - Matrix.diagonal f * state n c * Matrix.diagonal f) / 2 =
      2 * rectangularTraceNorm
        (fun (x : Positive f) (z : Negative f) => c ^ hammingDistance n x z / (2 : ℝ) ^ n)

name: Hellinger.CutNorm.rectangularTraceNorm_columns
statement:
theorem rectangularTraceNorm_columns (A : Matrix ι κ ℝ) (e : ι ≃ κ) :
    rectangularTraceNorm A = traceNorm (A.submatrix id e)

name: Hellinger.CutNorm.sqrt_eq_real_cfc
statement:
theorem sqrt_eq_real_cfc {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    CFC.sqrt A = cfc Real.sqrt A

name: Hellinger.CutNorm.sqrt_submatrix_equiv
statement:
theorem sqrt_submatrix_equiv {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (e : κ ≃ ι) :
    CFC.sqrt (A.submatrix e e) = (CFC.sqrt A).submatrix e e

name: Hellinger.CutNorm.traceNorm_offDiagonal
statement:
theorem traceNorm_offDiagonal (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    traceNorm (Matrix.fromBlocks 0 A A.transpose 0) = 2 * traceNorm A

name: Hellinger.CutNorm.traceNorm_transpose
statement: theorem traceNorm_transpose (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : traceNorm A.transpose = traceNorm A

name: Hellinger.CutNorm.value_negative

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.apply_signProbability
statement:
theorem apply_signProbability (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (y : Ω) (b : Bool) :

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.bscMutualInformation_KL_ne_top
statement:
theorem bscMutualInformation_KL_ne_top {n : ℕ} (f : PaperSpecs.Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : PaperSpecs.IsBoolean f) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    InformationTheory.klDiv (outputJoint (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) f)
      (((outputJoint (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) f).map Prod.fst).prod
        ((outputJoint (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) f).map Prod.snd)) ≠ ∞

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.bscMutualInformation_eq_posteriorInformation

theorem bscMutualInformation_eq_posteriorInformation {n : ℕ} (f : PaperSpecs.Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : PaperSpecs.IsBoolean f) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    bscMutualInformation f ρ hρ = PaperSpecs.posteriorInformation f ρ hρ

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.bscMutualInformation_le_of_hellinger
statement:
theorem bscMutualInformation_le_of_hellinger {n : ℕ} (f : PaperSpecs.Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : PaperSpecs.IsBoolean f) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hH : PaperSpecs.HellingerBound f ρ hρ) :
    bscMutualInformation f ρ hρ ≤ 1 - PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - ρ) / 2)

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.cubeBSC_joint_mass
statement:
theorem cubeBSC_joint_mass (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (x y : PaperSpecs.Cube n) :
    channelMass (cubeBSC n ρ hρ) (x, y) =
      (2 ^ n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∏ i, if y i = x i then (1 + ρ) / 2 else (1 - ρ) / 2

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.mean_signProbability

theorem mul_log_div_of_support (p q : ℝ) (h : q = 0 → p = 0) :

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.outputJoint_mutualInformation
statement:
theorem outputJoint_mutualInformation (K : UniformChannel Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) :
    mutualInformationBits (outputJoint K f) =
      PaperSpecs.binaryEntropyBits ((1 - mean f) / 2) -

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.posteriorJoint_mutualInformation

name: Hellinger.FiniteInformation.posteriorMass_KL_sum
statement:
theorem posteriorMass_KL_sum {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (u : Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ y, u y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∑ p, posteriorMass u p * Real.log (posteriorMass u p / productMass u p)) =
      Real.binEntropy ((1 - mean u) / 2) - mean (fun y => Real.binEntropy ((1 - u y) / 2))

name: Hellinger.OddDual.bsc_weight_antipode
statement:
theorem bsc_weight_antipode (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x y : Bool) :
    (bsc ρ hρ).weight (!x) (!y) = (bsc ρ hρ).weight x y

name: Hellinger.OddDual.bsc_weight_symm
statement:
theorem bsc_weight_symm (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x y : Bool) :
    (bsc ρ hρ).weight x y = (bsc ρ hρ).weight y x

name: Hellinger.OddDual.coordinate_functional
statement:
theorem coordinate_functional (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (negative : Bool) (t ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    dualFunctional (fun x : Cube n => t * (if negative then -boolSign (x i) else boolSign (x i)))
      ρ hρ = Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2) - |t| * ρ

name: Hellinger.OddDual.cube_weight_antipode
statement:
theorem cube_weight_antipode (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (x y : Cube n) : (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight (antipode n x) (antipode n y) =
      (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight x y

name: Hellinger.OddDual.cube_weight_symm
statement:
theorem cube_weight_symm (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (x y : Cube n) : (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight x y = (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).weight y x

name: Hellinger.OddDual.endpoint_one_approach
statement:
theorem endpoint_one_approach (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧
      0 < dualFunctional (fun x : Cube n => t * boolSign (x i)) 1 (by norm_num) ∧
      dualFunctional (fun x : Cube n => t * boolSign (x i)) 1 (by norm_num) < ε

name: Hellinger.OddDual.noise_odd
statement:
theorem noise_odd (n : ℕ) (h : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hodd : ∀ x, h (antipode n x) = -h x) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (y : Cube n) : (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply h (antipode n y) = -(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply h y

name: Hellinger.OddDual.noise_selfadjoint
statement:
theorem noise_selfadjoint (n : ℕ) (f g : Cube n → ℝ)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun y => f y * (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply g y) =
      mean (fun x => g x * (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f x)

name: Hellinger.OddDual.noise_signed_coordinate
statement:
theorem noise_signed_coordinate (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (negative : Bool)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Cube n) :
    (cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply
        (fun y => if negative then -boolSign (y i) else boolSign (y i)) x =
      ρ * (if negative then -boolSign (x i) else boolSign (x i))

name: Hellinger.OddDual.oddSign_boolean
statement:
theorem oddSign_boolean {n : ℕ} (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) (x : Cube (n + 1)) :
    oddSign g x = -1 ∨ oddSign g x = 1

name: Hellinger.OddDual.oddSign_mul
statement:
theorem oddSign_mul {n : ℕ} (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) (x : Cube (n + 1)) :
    oddSign g x * g x = |g x|

name: Hellinger.OddDual.oddSign_odd
statement:
theorem oddSign_odd {n : ℕ} (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hodd : ∀ x, g (antipode (n + 1) x) = -g x) (x : Cube (n + 1)) :
    oddSign g (antipode (n + 1) x) = -oddSign g x

name: Hellinger.OddDual.odd_dual_bound
statement:
theorem odd_dual_bound (n : ℕ) (h : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hodd : ∀ x, h (antipode (n + 1) x) = -h x)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : root ρ ≤ dualFunctional h ρ hρ

name: Hellinger.OddDual.odd_dual_bound_all
statement:
theorem odd_dual_bound_all (n : ℕ) (h : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hodd : ∀ x, h (antipode n x) = -h x)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : root ρ ≤ dualFunctional h ρ hρ

name: Hellinger.OddDual.odd_dual_equality_form
statement:
theorem odd_dual_equality_form (n : ℕ) (h : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hodd : ∀ x, h (antipode (n + 1) x) = -h x)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (heq : dualFunctional h ρ hρ = root ρ) :
    ∃ i : Fin (n + 1), ∃ negative : Bool,
      h = fun x => (ρ / root ρ) * (if negative then -boolSign (x i) else boolSign (x i))

name: Hellinger.OddDual.odd_dual_equality_iff
statement:
theorem odd_dual_equality_iff (n : ℕ) (h : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hodd : ∀ x, h (antipode (n + 1) x) = -h x)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1) :
    dualFunctional h ρ hρ = root ρ ↔
      ∃ i : Fin (n + 1), ∃ negative : Bool,
        h = fun x => (ρ / root ρ) * (if negative then -boolSign (x i) else boolSign (x i))

name: Hellinger.OddDual.odd_dual_equality_iff_all
statement:
theorem odd_dual_equality_iff_all (n : ℕ) (h : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hodd : ∀ x, h (antipode n x) = -h x)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1) :
    dualFunctional h ρ hρ = root ρ ↔
      ∃ i : Fin n, ∃ negative : Bool,
        h = fun x => (ρ / root ρ) * (if negative then -boolSign (x i) else boolSign (x i))

name: Hellinger.OddDual.root_mean_le_dual
statement:
theorem root_mean_le_dual (n : ℕ) (h : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    mean (fun y => root ((cubeBSC (n + 1) ρ hρ).apply
      (oddSign ((cubeBSC (n + 1) ρ hρ).apply h)) y)) ≤ dualFunctional h ρ hρ

name: Hellinger.OddDual.scalar_dual
statement:
theorem scalar_dual (u t : ℝ) (hu : u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    root u + t * u ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2)

name: Hellinger.OddDual.scalar_dual_equality
statement:
theorem scalar_dual_equality (u t : ℝ) (hu : u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (heq : root u + t * u = Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2)) : t * root u = u

name: Hellinger.OddDual.scaled_coordinate_attains
statement:
theorem scaled_coordinate_attains (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (negative : Bool)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hρlt : ρ < 1) :
    dualFunctional
      (fun x : Cube n => (ρ / root ρ) * (if negative then -boolSign (x i) else boolSign (x i)))
      ρ hρ = root ρ

name: Hellinger.OddDual.zero_attains_at_zero
statement:
theorem zero_attains_at_zero (n : ℕ) :
    dualFunctional (fun _ : Cube n => 0) 0 (by norm_num) = root 0

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.antipode_ne_self
statement: theorem antipode_ne_self (n : ℕ) (x : Cube (n + 1)) : antipode (n + 1) x ≠ x

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.antipode_twice
statement: theorem antipode_twice (n : ℕ) (x : Cube n) : antipode n (antipode n x) = x

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.apply_add
statement:
theorem apply_add {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (K : UniformChannel Ω)
    (f g : Ω → ℝ) (y : Ω) :
    K.apply (fun x => f x + g x) y = K.apply f y + K.apply g y

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.apply_completionOdd
statement:
theorem apply_completionOdd {n : ℕ} (K : UniformChannel (Cube n)) (x y z : Cube n) :
    K.apply (completionOdd x y) z =
      K.weight z x - K.weight z (antipode n x) + K.weight z y - K.weight z (antipode n y)

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.apply_delta
statement:
theorem apply_delta {n : ℕ} (K : UniformChannel (Cube n)) (x z : Cube n) :
    K.apply (delta x) z = K.weight z x

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.apply_exceptionalEven
statement:
theorem apply_exceptionalEven {n : ℕ} (K : UniformChannel (Cube n)) (x y z : Cube n) :
    K.apply (exceptionalEven x y) z =
      K.weight z x + K.weight z (antipode n x) - K.weight z y - K.weight z (antipode n y)

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.apply_sub
statement:
theorem apply_sub {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (K : UniformChannel Ω)
    (f g : Ω → ℝ) (y : Ω) :
    K.apply (fun x => f x - g x) y = K.apply f y - K.apply g y

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.average_completion_improvement
statement:
theorem average_completion_improvement (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ) (x y : Cube n)
    (hmean : mean f = 0)
    (hpair : ∀ z, f z + f (antipode n z) = 2 * exceptionalEven x y z)
    (hp : ∀ z, plusCompletion f x y z = -1 ∨ plusCompletion f x y z = 1)
    (hm : ∀ z, minusCompletion f x y z = -1 ∨ minusCompletion f x y z = 1)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) ≤
      (objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (plusCompletion f x y)) +
        objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply (minusCompletion f x y))) / 2

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.completionOdd_odd
statement:
theorem completionOdd_odd (n : ℕ) (x y z : Cube n) :

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.completion_agrees_outside
statement:
theorem completion_agrees_outside {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ) (x y z : Cube n)
    (hzx : z ≠ x) (hzax : z ≠ antipode n x) (hzy : z ≠ y) (hzay : z ≠ antipode n y) :
    plusCompletion f x y z = f z ∧ minusCompletion f x y z = f z

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.completion_boolean
statement:
theorem completion_boolean {n : ℕ} (f : Cube n → ℝ) (x y : Cube n)
    (hf : ∀ z, f z = -1 ∨ f z = 1)
    (hdata : ∀ z, (exceptionalEven x y z = f z ∧
          (completionOdd x y z = 1 ∨ completionOdd x y z = -1)) ∨
        (exceptionalEven x y z = 0 ∧ completionOdd x y z = 0)) :
    (∀ z, plusCompletion f x y z = -1 ∨ plusCompletion f x y z = 1) ∧
      (∀ z, minusCompletion f x y z = -1 ∨ minusCompletion f x y z = 1)

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.exceptional_data
statement:
theorem exceptional_data (n : ℕ) (f : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) (x y : Cube (n + 1))
    (hyx : y ≠ x) (hyax : y ≠ antipode (n + 1) x)
    (hfx : f x = 1) (hfax : f (antipode (n + 1) x) = 1)
    (hfy : f y = -1) (hfay : f (antipode (n + 1) y) = -1)
    (hother : ∀ z, z ≠ x → z ≠ antipode (n + 1) x → z ≠ y → z ≠ antipode (n + 1) y →
      f (antipode (n + 1) z) = -f z) :
    (∀ z, f z + f (antipode (n + 1) z) = 2 * exceptionalEven x y z) ∧
      ∀ z, (exceptionalEven x y z = f z ∧
          (completionOdd x y z = 1 ∨ completionOdd x y z = -1)) ∨
        (exceptionalEven x y z = 0 ∧ completionOdd x y z = 0)

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.four_point_bounds
statement:
theorem four_point_bounds (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ z, f z = -1 ∨ f z = 1) (hmean : mean f = 0) (x y : Cube n)
    (hyx : y ≠ x) (hyax : y ≠ antipode n x)
    (hfx : f x = 1) (hfax : f (antipode n x) = 1)
    (hfy : f y = -1) (hfay : f (antipode n y) = -1)
    (hother : ∀ z, z ≠ x → z ≠ antipode n x → z ≠ y → z ≠ antipode n y →
      f (antipode n z) = -f z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    PaperSpecs.HellingerBound f ρ hρ ∧ PaperSpecs.CKBound f ρ hρ

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.four_point_completion
statement:
theorem four_point_completion (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ z, f z = -1 ∨ f z = 1) (hmean : mean f = 0) (x y : Cube n)
    (hyx : y ≠ x) (hyax : y ≠ antipode n x)
    (hfx : f x = 1) (hfax : f (antipode n x) = 1)
    (hfy : f y = -1) (hfay : f (antipode n y) = -1)
    (hother : ∀ z, z ≠ x → z ≠ antipode n x → z ≠ y → z ≠ antipode n y →
      f (antipode n z) = -f z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ g : Cube n → ℝ,
      (g = plusCompletion f x y ∨ g = minusCompletion f x y) ∧
      (∀ z, g z = -1 ∨ g z = 1) ∧
      (∀ z, g (antipode n z) = -g z) ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ x → z ≠ antipode n x → z ≠ y → z ≠ antipode n y → g z = f z) ∧
      objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f) ≤ objective ((cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply g)

name: Hellinger.FourPoint.minusCompletion_odd

name: Hellinger.SpectralContracts.anticommuting_witnesses
statement:
theorem anticommuting_witnesses (d : ℕ) (K F : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hK : K.PosSemidef) (_htrace : K.trace = 1)
    (hF : F.IsHermitian) (hF2 : F * F = 1) :
    IsGreatest {t : ℝ | ∃ Q : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ,
      Q.IsHermitian ∧ ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℂ) (n := Fin d) Q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      F * Q * F = -Q ∧ t = (K * Q).trace.re}
      (ComplexSpectral.traceNorm (K - F * K * F) / 2) ∧
    (∀ Q : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ, Q.IsHermitian →
      ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℂ) (n := Fin d) Q‖ ≤ 1 → F * Q * F = -Q →
      ∀ ψ : Fin d → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ψ‖ = 1 →
        (star ψ ⬝ᵥ F *ᵥ ψ).re ^ 2 + (star ψ ⬝ᵥ Q *ᵥ ψ).re ^ 2 ≤ 1)

name: Hellinger.SpectralContracts.exact_parity_spectrum_distance
statement:
theorem exact_parity_spectrum_distance (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ hA : (evenRestriction n c).IsHermitian,
    ∃ hB : (oddRestriction n c).IsHermitian,
      (∑ j, |hA.eigenvalues₀ j - hB.eigenvalues₀ j|) = c

name: Hellinger.SpectralContracts.gibbs_representation
statement:
theorem gibbs_representation (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ β : ℝ, 0 < β ∧ c = Real.tanh β ∧
      state n c = ((2 * Real.cosh β) ^ n)⁻¹ •
        NormedSpace.exp (β • ∑ i : Fin n, SpinState.spin n i)

name: Hellinger.SpectralContracts.oddRestriction_diagonal
statement:

name: Hellinger.SpectralContracts.ordered_matrix_comparison
statement:
theorem ordered_matrix_comparison (d : ℕ) (A B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (∑ j, |hA.eigenvalues₀ j - hB.eigenvalues₀ j|) ≤
      ComplexSpectral.traceNorm (A - B)

name: Hellinger.SpectralContracts.product_state_formula
statement:
theorem product_state_formula (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    state n c = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ • (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n =>
      1 + c • SpinState.spin n i)).prod ∧
    (∀ x z, state n c x z = c ^ hammingDistance n x z / (2 : ℝ) ^ n)

name: Hellinger.SpectralContracts.square_root_lifting
statement:
theorem square_root_lifting (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ) (hf : PaperSpecs.IsBoolean f)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ComplexSpectral.traceNorm
      (Complexification.complexify (state n (root ρ)) -
        Complexification.complexify (Matrix.diagonal f) *
        Complexification.complexify (state n (root ρ)) *
        Complexification.complexify (Matrix.diagonal f)) / 2 ≤
      PaperSpecs.posteriorRootMean f ρ hρ

name: Hellinger.SpectralContracts.three_qubit_counterexample
statement:
theorem three_qubit_counterexample (c : ℝ) (hc : c ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ P : Matrix (Cube 3) (Cube 3) ℂ,
      P.IsHermitian ∧ P * P = 1 ∧
      (∀ s, (Complexification.complexify (hadamard 3) * P *
        Complexification.complexify (hadamard 3)) s s = 0) ∧
      ComplexSpectral.traceNorm (Complexification.complexify (state 3 c) -
        P * Complexification.complexify (state 3 c) * P) / 2 = c * (1 + c ^ 2) / 2 ∧
      c * (1 + c ^ 2) / 2 < c ∧
      (∀ f : Cube 3 → ℝ, P ≠ Complexification.complexify (Matrix.diagonal f))

name: Hellinger.SpectralContracts.trace_equality
statement:
theorem trace_equality (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ) (hf : PaperSpecs.IsBoolean f)
    (hnonconstant : ∃ x z, f x ≠ f z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (_hρpos : 0 < ρ) (hρlt : ρ < 1)
    (heq : PaperSpecs.posteriorRootMean f ρ hρ =
      TraceNorm.traceNorm (state n (root ρ) -
        Matrix.diagonal f * state n (root ρ) * Matrix.diagonal f) / 2) :
    ∀ y z, |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f y| = |(cubeBSC n ρ hρ).apply f z|

name: Hellinger.FunctionContracts.bent_definition_equivalence
statement:
theorem bent_definition_equivalence (n : ℕ) (f : Cube n → ℝ) :
    Flatness.IsBent f ↔ ∀ s, |Fourier.walsh f s| = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℝ) / 2)

statement:

statement:
